items.author: Ryan Gladwin
items.content:
In brief
- President Trump’s TRUMP meme coin hit an all-time low of $0.896 over the weekend and is down almost 40% since the midterms.
- Analysts say the Democrats taking Congress, and their plans to use subpoena power on Trump’s crypto ventures, add more pressure.
- They expect the token to keep declining whether or not Trump is in office, pointing to its lack of utility and a large share of supply still to unlock.
President Trump's official meme coin has reached new lows since he suffered a major blow in the U.S. midterm elections. The token has dropped almost 40% since election day, and analysts warn that new congressional scrutiny could push it lower.
Over the weekend, the TRUMP coin touched $0.896, marking the lowest point the token had ever stooped. It has since bumped 8%, sitting at $0.965, which is still down almost 40% from election day and 98.7% from its all-time high of $73.43, set the day after it launched, per Decrypt data.
Luke Nolan, senior researcher at CoinShares, told Decrypt the midterms "added pressure to an already struggling token." Trading volume increased around the vote, and he believes some traders had bet on a Republican surprise win. He said there was a "visible unwind" that led to a "sharp drawdown" after the election results rolled out.
"Democrats take both chambers in January and plan to use their subpoena power on his crypto ventures. His net approval rating has almost never been lower," Max Shannon, senior associate at Bitwise Europe, told Decrypt. "It is still possible this continues to decline and, therefore, has a negative effect on these Trump-affiliated assets."
Other Trump-linked assets have also taken a hit. Since the election, World Liberty Financial's WLFI token has dropped 7.5%, per Decrypt data, and shares of the Trump Media & Technology Group have dropped 32%.
What is TRUMP?
Trump launched TRUMP on January 17, 2025, three days before his second inauguration, which Shannon described as "close to the peak of his popularity." Since then, the coin has faced significant scrutiny over how much the President and his family have profited from it. (The First Lady following suit and launching her own meme coin didn't help matters.)
The president’s crypto ventures also became a sticking point for the Clarity Act, a bill that aimed to provide a formal legal structure for most cryptocurrency activity. Democrats scrutinized the Trump family's involvement in the crypto industry, which profited them more than $1 billion in a year.
A July draft would have barred public officials and employees, along with their spouses, from issuing or sponsoring digital assets while in office. That draft didn’t extend to officials’ children, including Don Jr. and Eric Trump, and the provision would have expired in January 2029.
The bill failed a key Senate procedural vote in September. Patrick Witt, former executive director of the President’s Council of Advisers for Digital Assets, later said the “political issue of ethics really consumed everything else.”
TRUMP has "no value accrual, and it has been left in the dust of this narrative," Shannon said. "Google Trends shows searches for $TRUMP essentially flatlining since June 2025."
Nolan agreed, saying the coin’s appeal was "largely speculative," with no clear link between holding it and sharing in any underlying business success. The most it offered, he said, was the exclusive dinner to the top holders, which was both popular and controversial, depending on who you asked.
"In my view, that was just an attempt to prop up the token without actually creating any long-term demand for it," he said.
Interest in these dinners has dried up too. Ahead of the third gala scheduled for the event of the month, 185 holders of the token were invited to register, but only 130 wallets showed on the final leaderboard. Those wallets held a combined $8.6 billion worth of TRUMP, according to Reuters, which is a 94% decline from the first dinner.
Then there's the "unappealing" token supply structure, Nolan said. The majority of tokens were allocated to Trump-linked entities and are being slowly unlocked, which means demand needs to keep growing to soak up newly injected supply.
"That is a difficult position for an asset whose main attraction is attention around one individual," he said.
And what happens when Trump loses power? He has said he "would love" to serve a third term, but that remains unconstitutional—so the clock is ticking on his presidency.
"I think overall Trump leaving office probably means the token continues its gradual decline," Nolan told Decrypt. "Any big Trump headlines probably make it experience the same dead cat bounces (sharp rallies) we have seen it have during short periods of time."
Shannon thinks Trump doesn't even need to lose power for the token to keep going down. He said that it is "incredibly unlikely" that the token reclaims its highs, as it would require it to boost 82x, too many investors have been burned, and the majority of the supply is still to be unlocked.
"I think the meme coin was doomed from the start, and like with most meme coins, creating long-term demand is a Sisyphean task," Nolan told Decrypt.

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
Recent outages at the National Security Agency, Federal Aviation Administration, National Weather Service, Microsoft, JPMorgan, and Apple are escalating a disturbing trend of US infrastructure destabilization.
As frontier AI advances its hacking capabilities, many people are concerned about rogue agents, cyber-extortion groups, and even state-sponsored hacking groups.
On Tuesday, the NSA’s internal classified network went down in what the agency called “temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance.”
The same day, a software update knocked Apple users off iCloud and the App Store. Ostensibly routine network maintenance disrupted the National Weather Service’s website for about an hour, too.
That was just one day, as widespread infrastructure failures have now stretched into their sixth consecutive day.
Six consecutive days of US infrastructure outages
Major outages began by Thursday, November 12, when a latent software bug left over 80% of Microsoft 365’s gateway servers unresponsive.
That outage disrupted Outlook and Teams for nearly 24 hours, and Downdetector logged reports from more than 90 countries and territories.
The Microsoft outage even broke the connectors feeding OpenAI’s and Anthropic’s AI services.
Friday was worse. A nationwide FAA ground stop was the longest since September 11, 2001. The prime suspect is a router installed by contractor L3Harris whose ex-CEO cashed out $21 million prior to the incident.
Operators canceled about 12,500 flights that day, and Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy puts the economic toll in the billions.
The weekend offered no relief. Workday serves more than 11,500 organizations, and it was down from Friday evening into Saturday. Many workers found they could not clock in or deal with payroll.
Follow-on flight disruptions continued through Sunday from the earlier FAA outage.
On Monday, a software bug in JPMorgan Chase’s on-premise hardware slowed transactions at the largest US bank, and Downdetector also showed user reports at Bank of America, US Bank, and Wells Fargo, including Zelle service outages.
Also on Monday, United Airlines grounded or delayed departing flights for more than 90 minutes after pilots reported losing aircraft data.
Read more: Linux earns ‘worst bug in the history of the internet’ status
‘98% certainty this isn’t a cyberattack’
The disruptions follow a string of failures this year. US infrastructure failures in 2026 include Linux, Virginia data centers, an August Microsoft 365 outage, Philadelphia’s air traffic control, and a CSX railroad outage.
Donald Trump’s administration doesn’t want to attribute any of the incidents to foreign cyberattacks. US Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin claimed, “98% certainty this isn’t a cyberattack.”
Even President Trump shrugged yesterday, “Things like that happen. It’s fine.” Asked about the FAA flight outage, he downplayed the situation, saying, “Essentially, what you saw was very old equipment that had a heart attack.”
Unconvinced, a Republican Senator countered, “If this is all a coincidence, it’s like the greatest coincidence in the history of the world.”
Tech and infrastructure outages continue to generate headlines this week, and Protos is covering events live as they unfold. As we update this liveblog, new entries will populate below.

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Anchorage Digital's Diogo Mónica warned that AI tools that can find and exploit vulnerabilities on their own will make the coming year "absolutely brutal."
- Solana Foundation security chief Michael Coates said more than $7.5 billion in crypto has been stolen this year, most of it in the Binance hack.
- Coates pointed crypto teams to the foundation's free STRIDE security framework, while both executives urged firms to lock down devices and keys.
Crypto companies face a wave of AI-powered attacks over the coming year, on top of an already relentless threat from North Korea, security leaders warned at Solana's Breakpoint conference in London.
"The next 12 months are going to be absolutely brutal," said Diogo Mónica, co-founder of crypto bank Anchorage Digital. "They're going to be a slaughterhouse."
Over the past three to six months, AI systems have gone from finding vulnerabilities to building full exploits and carrying out every step of an attack on their own, Mónica said on a panel chaired by Gordon Corera, co-host of The Rest Is Classified podcast. Aggressive hacking tools now let anyone with no security knowledge simply tell a model to "please hack this website," he said.
Michael Coates, chief information security officer at the Solana Foundation, said AI has "dramatically lowered the cost and the barrier to hacking." Projects that once escaped attention will now be targeted opportunistically, he said.
'Part of their GDP'
North Korea remains the biggest threat to crypto firms, Coates said in a separate presentation. More than $13 billion in crypto has been stolen over the past decade, over $7.5 billion of it this year alone, with some $6 billion drained in a single breach: last month's hack of Binance, which the FBI has blamed on North Korea. "This is how they fund their programs in North Korea," he said.
Coates described the Binance attack as a chain of familiar tactics. A developer downloaded poisoned software from a sponsored search result, and an engineer later took a job interview on a work device and downloaded software as part of it. That gave the attackers a foothold to move through the network and reach signing services, which they used to authorize malicious transactions rather than steal the keys themselves, he said.
Fake job interviews are a "telltale tactic of North Korea," he said, along with poisoned tools and deepfake video calls. North Korean hackers have stolen $400 million using deepfake calls alone. When North Korean operatives can't get hired directly, they use people in the U.S. to take jobs on their behalf, then connect remote keyboards and mice so attackers can access the company's network, Mónica said.
The U.S. Treasury recently sanctioned 11 people over just such a North Korean IT worker scheme. Anchorage now onboards new staff in person at its U.S. office, Mónica added, and every employee works on a locked-down Chromebook, logging into remote machines for development, which he said removes 90% to 95% of its corporate attack surface.
'Protect the keys'
Coates pointed teams to STRIDE, a free security framework the Solana Foundation launched in the spring. It sets out 18 core controls tailored for crypto, and protocols covering more than 74% of DeFi's total value locked on Solana, including 10 of the top 11, have gone through it, he said. The foundation is also using AI to reverse-engineer newly launched programs and find flaws before attackers do, which he said has prevented more than $5 million in potential losses in the past month.
Both executives warned against basic mistakes. Connecting email inboxes to AI agents invites prompt injection attacks, Mónica said, while Coates urged teams to "protect the keys," using hardware security keys for logins and properly configured multisig wallets, with plans for key rotation and loss. "That's where we see the attackers going," Coates said. "They're getting the entry points through the basics. They're pivoting around to get the keys, and that's where they're unleashing their fury."

items.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo
items.content:
Quick Take
- Surging Texas electricity prices made shutting down more profitable than mining Bitcoin for some operators, contributing to a 9.13% difficulty drop.
- Riot's $24.7 million in earlier power credits shows how miners can earn revenue by returning electricity to the grid instead of producing BTC.
- As miners return online, Bitcoin's next difficulty adjustment could erase nearly all the relief from the Nov. 14 reduction.
Surging Texas electricity prices made shutting down more profitable than mining Bitcoin for some operators in early November.
The disruption contributed to Bitcoin's 9.13% mining difficulty reduction on Nov. 14, its largest since June, as expensive electricity forced miners to reconsider whether keeping their machines running was worthwhile.
In a Nov. 17 analysis, mining services firm Luxor found that West Texas electricity prices exceeded the mining revenue of a machine operating at 25 joules per terahash during 45% of the hours between Oct. 29 and Nov. 14. That compares with just 9% during the preceding difficulty period.
The pressure intensified between Nov. 7 and Nov. 11, when average daily electricity prices ranged from $64 to $122 per megawatt-hour. Meanwhile, the modeled mining equipment generated approximately $54 in revenue for every megawatt-hour consumed, before electricity and other operating costs.
Luxor estimated that higher electricity prices alone accounted for roughly four-fifths of the increase in unprofitable mining hours, suggesting energy costs drove the disruption rather than Bitcoin's declining price.
The resulting shutdowns reduced the computing power securing Bitcoin's network, contributing to the difficulty adjustment that lowered the measure to 134.82 trillion from 148.36 trillion.
Why switching off can pay more than mining Bitcoin
While miners exposed to wholesale electricity prices could avoid losses by shutting down, companies with favorable power contracts had another opportunity.
Bitcoin mining company Riot Platforms, for example, can temporarily suspend operations and return contracted electricity to the grid in exchange for credits when market prices exceed its fixed electricity rates.
According to its third-quarter SEC filing, Riot earned $24.7 million in power curtailment credits during the three months ended Sept. 30, including $22.9 million from voluntarily reducing electricity consumption.
Those earnings preceded November's electricity surge but demonstrate how the arrangement works.
Consider a miner generating $54 in Bitcoin revenue per megawatt-hour while paying a fixed electricity rate of $35.
Continuing operations would produce $19 after electricity costs. However, if wholesale electricity prices reached $100 and the operator could return its contracted power, it could receive a $65 credit instead.
Under those assumptions, switching off would generate $46 more per megawatt-hour than continuing to mine.
That difference helps explain why electricity markets can influence Bitcoin mining activity independently of cryptocurrency prices.
Bitcoin's 9% difficulty relief faces a rapid reversal
However, the relief from November's shutdowns may prove short-lived.
Luxor estimated that Bitcoin's computing power recovered to approximately 1,100 exahashes per second as West Texas electricity prices eased between Nov. 13 and Nov. 15, even as Bitcoin's price continued falling.
The recovery accelerated block production after the difficulty reduction, raising the prospect of another substantial adjustment.
Through Nov. 17, Bitcoin blocks had averaged approximately 9.11 minutes since the reset, faster than the network's targeted 10-minute interval.
If that pace persists throughout the current difficulty period, the next adjustment could increase difficulty by approximately 9.85%, reversing nearly all the previous reduction. Even if block production slows to 10 minutes for the remaining period, the early acceleration would still produce an estimated 2.72% increase.
The extent of that rebound will depend partly on whether Texas electricity prices remain low enough to keep miners operating.
items.title: Bitcoin miners found a way to profit without mining BTC, but the advantage may not last

Perplexity推出多模型API：Claude拒答可切GPT，63道编程题多解3道

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Perplexity 发布 Orchestrator API，将 GPT、Claude、Gemini、Grok，以及 GLM、Kimi、DeepSeek 等 45 款以上模型整合到同一个接口。开发者只需一套 API 密钥，就能调用不同公司的模型，统一结算费用。

它提供两层自动调度。第一层解决服务稳定性：例如 Anthropic 的 Claude 接口报错、限流或超时，系统就尝试切换到 AWS Bedrock 提供的同款 Claude，不需要开发者手动处理。

第二层是按任务自动选择模型。开发者可以用自然语言指定规则，例如简单代码修改交给便宜的 GLM-5.3 Flash，复杂故障排查交给 Claude Opus 5.5，跨模块设计交给 GPT-6.1 Sol。系统会读取当前对话，由一个专门的决策模型判断该用谁。即使中途切换模型，也能继续读取此前的完整对话。如果后来切回原模型，还可以尝试复用它之前留下的缓存，减少重复计算。

Perplexity 还测试了一个特殊用途：当 Claude 因安全限制拒绝正常任务时，改用 GPT 继续处理。团队针对网络安全、生物学和拒答后的请求设置了切换规则。在 Terminal-Bench 4.1 的 63 道编程题中，Claude Fable 5.2 单独完成 38 道，加入路由后完成 41 道，但每道任务的估算成本也有所上升。

Anthropic预计今日完成IPO定价，机构如何看待估值和目标价？

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，Anthropic 预计今日完成 IPO 定价，明天（11 月 19 日）起在纳斯达克以代码 ANT 正式开始交易。官方招股书给出的发行价区间是每股 70 到 78 美元，对应完全稀释后估值最高约 1.4 万亿美元。这比早前市场传闻的接近 2 万亿美元目标有所下调，但仍大幅高于今年 5 月最后一轮私募的约 9650 亿美元。

目前多家机构已经给出了自己的估值展望，分歧比较明显。

独立投研机构 Morningstar 的基准情景给出约 1.7 万亿美元（与当前 Trade.xyz 上相同）的公允价值，认为当前 IPO 定价区间偏低，中点位置有大约 24% 的上行空间。他们的牛市情景超过 3 万亿美元，熊市情景则只有约 5000 亿美元，主要假设未来五年收入复合增速在 47% 左右。⁠

研究机构 New Street Research 更乐观一些，直接给了「买入」评级，12 个月目标价 105 美元，相对发行区间有 35% 到 50% 的上涨空间。他们预计公司收入将从 2026 年的大约 530 亿美元，到 2030 年突破 5000 亿美元，同时计算能力从年底的约 5 GW 扩张到 30 GW。⁠

印度 Ashika Institutional Equities 则将焦点放在 2027 年收入上，基准情景预计约 1110 亿美元，谨慎情景 885 亿美元，乐观情景可以到 1370 亿美元以上。按这个收入算，当前 IPO 定价对应的 2027 年 EV/Sales 大约在 9.5 到 10.7 倍，和 AI 基础设施公司的中位数接近。

纽约大学教授 Aswath Damodaran 根据招股书数据估出的股权价值大约在 1.475 万亿美元，处于早前讨论区间的偏低位置。

总体看，机构对收入高增长的方向比较一致，但对估值上限的判断差距较大。核心分歧在于计算成本能否持续下降、企业客户采用速度，以及和 OpenAI 等对手的竞争格局。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/378016

黄仁勋下一站猜测：Semafor记者预测其或筹集500亿美元再创业，重返英伟达概率为零

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，在最新一期 Prof G Markets 节目中，Semafor 商业记者 Rohan Goswami 预测，黄仁勋不会重返英伟达，而可能与长期支持他的朋友筹集并投入 500 亿美元创办新企业。对于黄仁勋回归英伟达的可能性，Rohan 给出的判断是 0%。

DB Live 创始人 Deirdre Bosa 则认为，黄仁勋仍存在回归可能。她指出，黄仁勋是主动辞去 CEO 职务，而非被董事会直接解雇；马斯克此前签署要求黄仁勋复职的网络请愿书，并公开表示聘请黄仁勋将是自己的荣幸，反映出硅谷科技圈对他的支持。不过，外界声援并不意味着英伟达董事会会改变决定。

两位嘉宾还讨论了黄仁勋离开对英伟达及 AI 产业生态的影响。Deirdre 认为，英伟达未来一至两年的产品路线图已基本确定，但长期能否延续技术领先，取决于继任者能否保持黄仁勋的战略判断力，并应对谷歌 TPU、亚马逊 Trainium 等产品的竞争。

需要注意的是，500 亿美元再创业属于 Rohan Goswami 在节目中的个人预测，并非黄仁勋已公布的计划；目前也没有证据表明黄仁勋与马斯克旗下企业就任职或合作展开正式谈判。

替投行新人做Excel和PPT，Model ML融资2.5亿美元，晋升独角兽

动察 Beating AI 快讯，伦敦 AI 创企 Model ML 宣布完成 2.5 亿美元 B 轮融资，估值达到 15 亿美元，正式晋升独角兽。本轮由 General Atlantic 和 QED Investors 联合领投。

Model ML 专门替投行初级分析师和咨询顾问处理繁琐工作，包括搭建 Excel 财务模型、制作融资和并购演示 PPT、撰写尽职调查报告。

它的 AI 智能体能接入企业内部数据和 Office 软件，掌握整笔交易的背景。例如，一笔交易的关键财务假设发生变化，AI 就能同步修改相关 Excel 表格，并更新对应的分析和演示材料，不用分析师逐份修改。智能体还可以主动跟踪企业新闻，判断对交易的影响，提前准备分析报告。

Model ML 会根据任务选择不同模型，部分工作交给自家微调的开源模型。按照公司自测，这些模型在适用的金融任务上，运行成本仅为前沿大模型的 2%，大多数情况下速度快 5 倍，准确率相当甚至更高。

Model ML 披露，今年第三季度的年化经常性收入同比增长 12 倍，日活跃用户增长 26 倍。

金融 AI 赛道的竞争已经相当激烈。另一家专攻投行工作的创企 Rogo，今年 4 月融资 1.6 亿美元，估值达到 20 亿美元。OpenAI 和 Anthropic 也已推出面向金融专业人士的 AI 产品。

Cognition推出Devin Bots：一个人管20个AI，每周处理1900个PR

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AI 编程公司 Cognition 发布 Devin Bots，让 Devin 从执行单个编程任务，升级为能够长期管理整个项目的 AI 工程主管。

你只需要交代目标，比如「让安卓 App 始终跟上 iOS 版本」，它就会自己发现问题、拆分任务、指挥多个 Devin 并行写代码、测试和审查。遇到需要人工决策的事项，再集中向你汇报。整个过程可以持续数周，无需人工不断分配新任务。

Cognition 展示了一个内部案例。一名工程师让 Devin Bot 负责开发公司的安卓 App。44 天里，AI 自己创建和处理工单，最终关闭 1217 个工单，合并 1134 个代码修改请求（PR），并把 App 推进 Google Play 公开测试。期间，负责监督的工程师只发了 183 条消息，其中 22 天完全没有发消息。

另一个案例更夸张。Cognition 成员 Jenny Xu 的手游工作室只有她一名真人，却有约 20 个 AI 员工，分别负责开发、测试、版本发布和用户反馈。她只需要与一个名叫 SuperJenny 的总管 Bot 沟通。工作室每周处理的 PR 从约 50 个增加到 1900 个，并保持每周发布新版本。

Devin Bots 现已上线，支持每月 200 美元的 Max 套餐及每月 80 美元起的 Teams 套餐。每月 20 美元的 Pro 套餐暂不包含该功能。

TD Cowen维持SharpLink买入评级及13美元目标价，下调ETH价格预期

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，TD Cowen 周三维持以太坊储备公司 SharpLink（SBET）买入评级及 13 美元目标价，但因 ETH 单笔交易销毁量明显下降，下调对 ETH 价格走势的预期。

TD Cowen 预计，ETH 将于 2026 年第四季度末达到约 2,413 美元，较第三季度末下降约 10%，此后价格升值路径也将更加平缓。分析师 Lance Vitanza 指出，尽管以太坊网络活动保持强劲，但交易量增长并未带来相应的 ETH 销毁量，促使该机构采取更谨慎的价格预测。

与此同时，TD Cowen 看好 SharpLink 的主动资金管理策略。该公司 ETH 持仓从第三季度末的 892,708 枚增至截至 11 月 16 日的 896,003 枚，近期增量主要来自质押收益，而非新增购买，累计质押奖励已达 31,820 枚 ETH。公司还向 Lido 配置了 2 亿美元，并投资 Galaxy Sharplink Onchain Yield Fund，以提高 ETH 持仓收益。

TD Cowen 认为，若 ETH 价格回暖，SharpLink 有望通过增加每股 ETH 持有量，大幅跑赢现货 ETH ETF；若 ETH 价格持续低迷，质押收益也有望覆盖公司运营成本。

OpenAI联创John Schulman：AI对齐应成为公共科学，不能由少数科技公司主导

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Thinking Machines 联合创始人、OpenAI 联创 John Schulman 在 A16Z 播客节目中表示，AI 对齐不应成为少数几家科技公司的专属研究，而应发展为一门面向全球的公共科学，让更多人参与 AI 价值观的塑造，避免过度依赖少数公司的判断。

随着递归自我改进（RSI）逐渐取得进展，AI 已开始辅助模型研发。OpenAI 首席研究官 Mark Chen 透露，AI 研发流程已出现 RSI 加速效应的早期信号，目前进展约为 25% 至 50%，但 AI 仍难以独立判断有价值的研究方向，尚未实现自主研发下一代模型。

Mark Chen 同时警告，随着模型自主性增强，若其目标与人类意图不一致，长时间运行可能产生意料之外的次级目标。不过，更强大的 AI 也有望反过来帮助研究人员监控模型行为、发现并修复对齐问题。

John Schulman 强调，AI 对齐不仅是技术问题，也涉及由谁决定 AI 应遵循的价值观，用户和社会应拥有更多参与和塑造 AI 价值观的空间。

items.author: Gino Matos
items.content:
Quick Take
- Ripple contributed 126.8 million XRP to Pathfinder at zero book value, a new SEC filing reveals.
- Evernorth's XRP holdings also carry roughly $505 million in historical write-downs, widening the gap between book and market values.
- Outside ownership, convertible debt and potential dilution complicate how much XRP-backed value belongs to Evernorth shareholders.
Ripple contributed 126.8 million XRP to Evernorth at a recorded value of zero, according to a Nov. 17 SEC filing.
The disclosure adds another wrinkle to the valuation of Evernorth's XRP treasury, which has already suffered roughly $505 million in cumulative write-downs.
The zero-cost lot reflects the basis inherited from Ripple, while the impairment reflects reductions in the carrying amount of Evernorth's historical XRP position. Neither figure establishes what the combined business is worth today.
Evernorth's Sept. 30 financial statements report 346.3 million XRP with an original cost of $846.6 million and a carrying amount of $341.9 million.
Only $6.9 million of impairment was recognized in the third quarter. The nine-month charge was $271 million, while the rest of the cumulative reduction predates 2026.
Under the policy disclosed in the filing, later price recoveries do not reverse the written-down basis, so the gap between book value and market value can persist.
The new amendment clarifies the distinction by adding financial statements for Pathfinder, Evernorth's XRP-holding subsidiary, and updated combined pro forma accounts.
Pathfinder's statements said Ripple contributed 126,791,458 XRP on Oct. 19, 2025. Because the transfer was a transaction between entities under common control, Pathfinder recognized the tokens at Ripple's historical carrying value, which was zero.
The statements also report a merger-related transfer of 346.5 million XRP from Evernorth to Pathfinder. Adding that transfer to Ripple's historical contribution reconstructs approximately 473.3 million XRP from the two disclosed transactions.
The combined pro forma accounts continue historical-cost-less-impairment treatment without a fair-value adjustment. They show $342.2 million of net digital assets, a carrying amount based on that accounting policy.
Public XRP ownership changes the valuation test
The 10-Q describes Evernorth's ownership of Pathfinder common units as approximately 71.5%. For the Oct. 9 closing, the pro forma table separately reports 55 million Evernorth shares across both classes and 23 million outside Pathfinder units.
As of Nov. 9, Evernorth reported 58.4 million Class A and Class C shares. Evernorth defines its XRP-per-share KPI as tokens attributable to the public parent divided by the combined number of shares in both classes.
The pro forma balance sheet reports $76 million in cash and $46.3 million in total liabilities, including a $30 million convertible note. It also presents $229.5 million of redeemable noncontrolling interest separately.
The balance sheet presents that outside interest separately from debt, and the note is already included in total liabilities.
The 10-Q subsequently reports $35.3 million in gross warrant proceeds through Nov. 9, plus 8.7 million warrants still outstanding at an $11.50 exercise price. The convertible note can also accrue 4% payment-in-kind interest and has conversion provisions.
The next useful valuation comparison needs a common date for XRP inventory, Evernorth's economic ownership, cash, liabilities, and the share count, with potential dilution shown separately.
The amendment explains why a large write-down and a zero-book-value XRP lot can coexist, while a current market valuation still requires the dated financial bridge.
items.title: Ripple’s 126.8 million XRP valued at $0 in Evernorth filing as $505 million write-down emerges

新加坡筹建AI支付沙盒：合同履约后自动打款，银行仍须担责

动察 Beating AI 快讯，新加坡金融管理局（MAS）与未来金融研究院（FFI）公布三项金融 AI 任务的具体推进方案：利用 AI 打击诈骗、改善中小企业融资，以及让 AI 智能体安全地执行金融交易。

最值得关注的是，新加坡将建立 Agentic Money Sandbox（智能体货币沙盒），让银行测试 AI 使用数字货币自主付款、管理资金，甚至在不同金融机构之间执行交易。

这套方案计划结合「限定用途货币」（Purpose Bound Money），提前为资金设置使用条件、授权范围和额度。比如，AI 核实合同约定的义务已经履行后，就可以按照预设规则自动付款，无须人工逐笔操作。

沙盒还将测试智能体的身份验证、权限控制、交易追踪和责任归属。即使交易由 AI 完成，相关金融机构和企业仍须承担责任。目前这些功能尚处于测试规划阶段。

反诈骗方面，已有 5 家银行联合测试 AI 识别跨行诈骗资金流向。 新加坡计划在 2027 年初启动全行业诈骗检测系统的设计研究，同时向符合条件的开发者提供合成数据。中小企业融资方面，则将测试 AI 能否利用银行流水、发票等数据，帮助缺少信用记录或抵押物的企业获得贷款。

英伟达、AMD、英特尔罕见联手：9家企业共建SGLang开源推理联盟

动察 Beating AI 快讯，在首届 SGLang Summit 上，平日竞争激烈的 NVIDIA、AMD 和 Intel 罕见地站到了同一阵营。

三家芯片巨头与 Google、Meta、Thinking Machines Lab、Cloudflare、Modal、RadixArk 共同成为 SGLang 联盟的 9 家创始成员，参与制定这款开源 AI 推理引擎的未来路线图。峰会吸引超过 2000 人现场参加。

SGLang 是大模型运行时的底层软件，负责处理用户请求、调度 GPU、管理显存和复用计算结果。它直接决定一张芯片能以多快的速度、多少成本运行 AI 模型。

SGLang 此前已经支持 NVIDIA、AMD、Intel 等多种硬件。此次成立联盟，意味着芯片厂商将更系统地参与共同开发，投入工程师、测试资源，并推动各自硬件的性能优化。

联盟成员每年举行两次路线图会议，但最终技术决策和代码合并权仍由 SGLang 维护团队掌握。

SGLang 官方称，目前已有 332 家机构采用该项目。Meta 也在峰会上披露，相比此前的推理方案，迁移至 SGLang 后，其大规模生产环境中的 GPU 资源节省超过一半。

峰会还宣布了 SGLang v1.0 的开发方向，重点提升生产环境的稳定性和兼容性，正式版本仍在开发中。此外，SGLang 已推出 AWS Trainium 芯片的公开预览支持，并与 Intel 合作优化其 CPU、GPU 和加速器。强化学习框架 Miles v0.2 也已发布。

Bitwise Asset Management is seeking to list a spot Zcash exchange-traded fund (ETF) on the Texas Stock Exchange (TXSE), according to a registration statement filed with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
The S-1 filing names TXSE as the anticipated listing venue for the Bitwise Zcash ETF, which would trade under the ticker ZEC. The fund would hold Zcash directly and seek to reflect the value of its holdings, minus operating expenses and liabilities.
Coinbase Custody would safeguard the fund’s ZEC tokens, while Bitwise Investment Advisers would serve as its manager and sponsor.
The Bitwise fund has not begun trading, and its registration statement has yet to become effective. Its proposed annual sponsor fee also remains unspecified. The public filing also follows an Oct. 16 draft that identified NYSE Arca as the proposed exchange.
The filing comes as asset managers continue to expand their Zcash-linked investment products in the US.
Grayscale launched its Zcash ETF on NYSE Arca in August, becoming one of the first issuers to offer investors exposure to the cryptocurrency through a US-listed ETF. Meanwhile, Winklevoss Asset Services filed in October to launch a competing spot Zcash ETF on Nasdaq under the ticker WINK.

Bitcoin steadies after Nvidia’s earnings beat as $60K bids stand out
Bitcoin halted downside as Nvidia confidence returned, with its stock gaining 3% premarket and South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI reclaiming 5,000 points.
Bitcoin (BTC) steadied on Wednesday as US stock futures rose after Nvidia reported stronger-than-expected quarterly revenue.
Key points:
- Bitcoin returned to its $64,000–$66,000 trading range after Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in third-quarter revenue and forecast $130 billion for the fourth quarter.
- Nvidia shares rose about 3% in premarket trading on Wednesday, while South Korea’s KOSPI closed 2% higher at 5,067.
- Glassnode identified $60,000 as the lower end of a range where a further Bitcoin price drop could trigger long liquidations.
Nvidia stock gains 3% premarket
Data from TradingView showed Bitcoin returning to the $64,000–$66,000 range it had traded in since Nov. 15.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Bitcoin briefly fell below the range on Tuesday ahead of Nvidia’s earnings release. Nvidia then reported third-quarter revenue of $115.8 billion, above expectations of $108 billion, and forecast $130 billion for fourth quarter. Its shares rose about 3% to $160.60 in Wednesday’s premarket trading.
Nvidia futures one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
“Our momentum is real. NVIDIA is an exceptional technology leader, powered by the relentless innovation of our people,” interim CEO Colette Kress commented in a press release.
The momentum was reflected in broader equities performance, with Nasdaq 100 futures gaining 1%. South Korea’s tech-heavy KOSPI Composite closed 2% higher at 5,067 Wednesday, bouncing back above 5,000 after its lowest daily close since February.
KOSPI one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Meanwhile, Nvidia’s board rejected calls to reinstate former CEO Jensen Huang. On the earnings call, board chairman Harvey Jones said the directors had unanimously accepted Huang’s resignation.
“I’m good with Colette. She is clearly competent and strong. I feel that Nvidia is in a good spot and over time the right leadership will emerge,” Ross Gerber, cofounder, CEO and CIO at investment manager Gerber Kawasaki, wrote on X. Gerber compared Kress to Apple CEO Tim Cook and called it a “new chapter” for Nvidia.
Glassnode flags $60,000 level for Bitcoin
Optimism allowed Bitcoin to stay above 18-week lows of $62,000 seen Sunday. Analyzing Binance order-book composition, crypto research platform Glassnode emphasized the importance of the area around the $60,000 mark.
Related: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
“Within 5% of price, resting bids on Binance and Coinbase now outweigh asks about 2.3x. Since late August, bids have usually outweighed asks only slightly,” it wrote in the latest edition of The Week Onchain newsletter.
“The brightest band on the heatmap, near $60K, is the largest single bid level on Binance since August.”
Binance BTC spot order-book liquidity data. Source: Glassnode
Glassnode flagged $60,000 as the lower end of a range where falling prices could force traders out of long positions and accelerate the sell-off. It added that the majority of forced position closures had “already happened” on the initial move down.
Bitcoin futures liquidation heatmap. Source: Glassnode

AMD完成约29亿美元收购Taalas：把AI模型刻进芯片，每秒生成1.7万Token

动察 Beating AI 快讯，AMD 宣布完成对加拿大 AI 芯片公司 Taalas 的收购。双方今年 8 月达成协议，交易总价值最高约 29 亿美元，其中最多 14 亿美元需要满足约定条件才会支付。

Taalas 走了一条与传统 GPU 完全不同的路线：在制造芯片时，就把 AI 模型的参数直接固化进电路。

普通 GPU 需要反复从显存读取模型参数。Taalas 把存储和计算放在一起，减少了数据搬运，也省去了昂贵的高带宽显存（HBM）及相关复杂封装。

今年 2 月，Taalas 推出首款芯片 HC1，专门运行 Meta 的 Llama 3.1 8B 模型。按官方测试，在输入和输出各 1000 Token 的条件下，单用户生成速度达到每秒约 1.7 万 Token，接近当时 Cerebras 的 9 倍。

但这种设计也牺牲了灵活性。普通 GPU 可以随时加载不同模型，HC1 虽然支持 LoRA 微调，但更换基础模型仍需修改制造光罩、重新生产芯片。Taalas 给出的周期是约两个月。

HC1 还采用了激进的 3-bit 和 6-bit 量化，虽然大幅压缩了模型参数，但也损失了部分模型质量。目前每秒 1.7 万 Token 的成绩仅来自 Llama 3.1 8B，更大模型的实际表现还有待验证。

AMD 准备将这项技术纳入未来的 AI 加速器产品，与现有的 Instinct GPU 搭配使用，让专用芯片承担固定模型的高频推理任务。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377999

items.author: Gino Matos
items.content:
Quick Take
- Bitcoin briefly surged above $64,600 after Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in quarterly revenue, beating Wall Street expectations.
- The rally surrendered most of its gains within 35 minutes, exposing fragile demand despite Nvidia's blockbuster earnings.
- With $2.6 billion in recent ETF outflows, Bitcoin faces a critical test of $62,000 support as traders await signs of sustained buying.
Bitcoin climbed to about $64,600 after Nvidia beat Wall Street’s revenue expectations Tuesday, then gave back most of the gain within 35 minutes.
In its first earnings report since Jensen Huang’s departure, Nvidia reported $115.8 billion in fiscal third-quarter revenue, up 103% from a year earlier, and topping the $109.1 billion Bloomberg analyst consensus.
Nvidia projected $130 billion in fourth-quarter revenue, plus or minus 3%, above the $125.2 billion analyst estimate Yahoo Finance reported. The forecast covers a quarter with an extra week and assumes zero data center compute revenue from China.
Nvidia’s board accepted Huang’s resignation effective Nov. 11 and disclosed it Nov. 12, according to the company’s SEC filing. Colette Kress took over as interim CEO while retaining her job as chief financial officer.
Nvidia released the figures at 4:20 p.m. ET, and Bitcoin traded close to $64,000 at the end of the one-minute interval before the report. It touched $64,602.98 during the 4:33 p.m. minute and was back to $64,246.47 by 4:55 p.m., still about $244 above its pre-release level.
Separately, Nvidia traded at $157.83 at 4:56:47 p.m. ET, up 1.52% from its $155.46 regular-session close.
Coinbase BTC/USD one-minute closing trades on Nov. 17, 2026. The first point is the trade immediately before Nvidia’s 4:20 p.m. ET release. Intraminute highs are outside this closing-price series.
What would make the Bitcoin rebound stick
In research published before Nvidia’s earnings, Glassnode found that losses from coins sold below their purchase price had reached levels seen around previous market lows, relative to profits over the preceding year.
Its model estimated that the Nov. 13-14 liquidations had cleared most leveraged long positions stacked above $62,000, leaving fewer of those previously mapped positions vulnerable to forced closure.
Glassnode estimated that about 20% of short-term holders’ coins had been acquired between $62,000 and $66,000. Within 5% of Bitcoin’s market price, the Binance and Coinbase order books showed about 2.3 times as much buy-side as sell-side liquidity.
Traders can withdraw those orders, so order book size only indicates how much buying might materialize. If the lower edge of the range gives way, Glassnode pointed to the June low near $58,500 and the aggregate realized price near $53,700, based on the prices at which coins last moved.
Glassnode also reported that the Coinbase premium, the difference between Bitcoin’s price on the exchange and its global price, turned positive around the weekend low before slipping back to a small discount.
Stablecoin supply fell 4.2% over 90 days while three-month Treasury bill yields rose about 45 basis points over that same period, making bills a more attractive place to hold cash.
US-traded spot Bitcoin ETFs also saw substantial withdrawals in the run-up to the report, as Glassnode reported $2.6 billion in net outflows over ten sessions.
Farside Investors’ daily totals added about $2.35 billion in withdrawals over that period, followed by a $7.9 million net inflow on Nov. 16. A longer run of ETF inflows and buyers consistently paying a premium on Coinbase would give the bounce more support.
At $74,100, Glassnode estimates that short-term holders as a group would break even, and Bitcoin’s initial move after Nvidia’s report left it well below that level.
items.title: Bitcoin’s failed Nvidia earnings rally puts $62,000 support back in the spotlight

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Tyler Buchanan, a 24-year-old Scot, was sentenced to six years in U.S. federal prison for a scheme that stole at least $11.6 million in crypto.
- Buchanan and his co-conspirators phished employees at a dozen companies, then used stolen data and SIM swaps to break into victims' crypto wallets.
- He is the last of five defendants to be sentenced in the case, which the Justice Department has linked to the Scattered Spider hacking group.
A Scottish hacker who was part of the Scattered Spider hacking collective has been sentenced to six years in U.S. federal prison for his role in a scheme that stole at least $11.6 million in crypto.
Tyler Robert Buchanan, 24, of Dundee, was sentenced to 72 months by a federal judge in Santa Ana, California, on Tuesday, the U.S. Attorney's Office for the Central District of California said. The judge set a restitution hearing for December 11. Buchanan began hacking as a teenager and was part of Scattered Spider, the group of young, English-speaking hackers blamed for a string of high-profile cyberattacks, the BBC reported.
British national sentenced to six years in federal prison for hacking into companies and stealing at least $11 million in virtual currency https://t.co/h7oprrXcVK
— US Attorney L.A. (@USAO_LosAngeles) November 18, 2026
Buchanan pleaded guilty in April to conspiracy to commit wire fraud and aggravated identity theft. At the time, prosecutors said the scheme had stolen at least $8 million in crypto. That figure has since risen to at least $11.6 million.
Phishing texts and SIM swaps
Between September 2021 and April 2023, Buchanan and his co-conspirators sent hundreds of phishing text messages to employees of at least a dozen companies, including telecoms, technology firms and crypto companies, according to the indictment and Buchanan's plea agreement. The messages linked to fake websites that captured employees' login details, which were sent to a Telegram channel run by Buchanan and another co-conspirator.
The group used information stolen from those companies to identify individual crypto holders, then carried out SIM swaps, tricking mobile carriers into moving victims' phone numbers to devices they controlled so they could intercept two-factor authentication codes and empty victims' wallets.
In the largest single theft, one victim lost $1.67 million in December 2022, according to the BBC. When authorities searched Buchanan's home in Scotland in April 2023, they found the names and addresses of numerous victims, and a text file containing crypto seed phrases and login details for one victim's account, prosecutors said.
"Those thefts had severe, life-altering consequences for many victims," prosecutors argued in a sentencing memo.
Five defendants sentenced
Buchanan is the fifth and final defendant to be sentenced in the case, which the Justice Department charged in November 2024. A Justice Department spokesperson confirmed at the time that the defendants were suspected members of Scattered Spider, the group behind high-profile attacks including the 2023 breach of MGM Resorts. Buchanan was arrested at Palma de Mallorca Airport in Spain in May 2024 while trying to board a private flight to Naples, the BBC reported, and has been in U.S. custody since April 2025.
His co-defendant Noah Urban, of Palm Coast, Florida, is serving 10 years in prison, while Ahmed Hossam Eldin Elbadawy and Evans Onyeaka Osiebo were each sentenced to 45 months, and Joel Martin Evans to two years.
U.S. authorities have continued to pursue alleged Scattered Spider members. In July, a 19-year-old suspect was extradited from Finland over an $8 million crypto ransom demand against a luxury jeweler.

Following a US Restriction Order, MEXC Global Card Announces Its Service Will End Today at 15:30 UTC; Existing Cards Will No Longer Be Usable for Transactions, and New Card Applications Will Be Suspended

MEXC announced that, due to service changes by its third-party card issuer, MEXC Global Card service will end on November 18, 2026, at 15:30 UTC. Existing cards will no longer be usable for transactions, and new card applications will be suspended. Users are advised to withdraw any remaining balance and cancel or change recurring subscription payments linked to the card before then. If a balance remains after the service ends, MEXC will take a balance snapshot on November 21 at 15:30 UTC, after pending transactions have settled, and automatically transfer the remaining funds to users’ spot accounts within three business days of the snapshot. — link

英伟达丑闻引发调查：民主党质疑商务部长利用职权为其子掌控的投资机构谋利

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，美国民主党议员已启动调查，核查美国商务部长霍华德・卢特尼克是否利用公职，帮助由其子掌控的投资机构建达（Cantor Fitzgerald）规避英伟达丑闻带来的损失。

据一封致卢特尼克 28 岁长子、建达董事长布兰登・卢特尼克的信函，众议院民主党议员杰米・拉斯金、格雷戈里・米克斯、悉尼・卡姆拉杰-多夫在信中表示，他们希望核实商务部长的各项举措，是否「受到建达公司持仓或商业利益的不当影响」。监管文件显示，建达近几个月减持英伟达股票。截至三季度，该公司持有这家芯片企业约 100 万股，按当前价格价值约 1.55 亿美元；去年年底持仓为 300 万股。

建达表示，信函中的说法「并不属实」，公司「没有持有重大的英伟达自营头寸」。建达称，相关持仓是为客户交易对冲而买入，英伟达持仓下降，是客户调整交易头寸导致，并非建达自身做出减持决定。美国商务部周二表示，卢特尼克已经剥离其在建达、地产公司纽马克（Newmark）以及券商 BGC 的全部权益。

items.author: Oluwapelumi Adejumo
items.content:
Quick Take
- Cardano Foundation seeks nearly $5 million in ADA funding as CEO Frederik Gregaard defends the network amid backlash over Hoskinson's remarks.
- Gregaard acknowledges Cardano must turn years of technological development into sustainable economic activity and wider adoption.
- The proposal targets thousands of industry contacts but sets no numerical goal for on-chain transactions, raising questions about measurable returns.
Cardano Foundation CEO Frederik Gregaard defended the blockchain's future as his organization sought nearly 25 million ADA to promote adoption.
In a Nov. 15 statement, Gregaard argued that Cardano had become technologically stronger and more decentralized, pushing back against growing concerns about the network's future following controversial remarks by founder Charles Hoskinson.
The comments followed a backlash against Hoskinson's declaration that Cardano's original development roadmap was complete, with some investors questioning whether the network had delivered on its broader ambitions.
Hoskinson later clarified that he meant the completion of Cardano's original engineering roadmap, not that development or his involvement with the ecosystem had ended.
However, Gregaard argued that Cardano's future should not depend on any single individual or organization. He said:
“Decentralization means that no single individual gets to decide when Cardano is finished.”
Cardano's technological progress faces an adoption test
Gregaard pointed to several developments he believes have strengthened Cardano's competitive position, including decentralized governance, alternative node implementations and new infrastructure for financial institutions.
He highlighted Amaru and Dingo, alternative implementations of Cardano's blockchain software written in Rust and Go, respectively, as advances that could reduce reliance on a single technology stack.
The executive also cited the introduction of ADA futures on CME Group and the launch of CIP-0113, a programmable token standard designed to support regulated financial assets.
According to Gregaard, the new standard has already enabled the tokenization of 850,000 shares in Veridian, a Swiss company spun out of the Cardano Foundation, structured as legally recognized securities under Swiss law.
The development lets companies embed compliance requirements, investor eligibility, and transfer restrictions directly into blockchain-based assets.
Gregaard believes these capabilities could position Cardano to compete in the growing market for tokenized stocks, bonds and other traditional financial instruments. He said:
“The Cardano I see today is fundamentally stronger, more decentralized, and more capable than the Cardano I came into over five years ago.”
However, the executive also acknowledged that technological progress alone would not determine Cardano's long-term success. Gregaard said:
“Of course, we need to translate more of these initiatives into production deployments, recurring transactions and sustainable economic activity.”
He added that Cardano needs to become more competitive, even as he defended the progress made across its ecosystem.
That challenge has become particularly relevant as the Foundation seeks additional community funding to expand Cardano's presence at major industry events.
Foundation seeks 25 million ADA to expand adoption efforts
On Nov. 16, the Cardano Foundation submitted a governance proposal requesting 24,995,775 ADA from the network's community treasury.
The request carries an estimated value of nearly $5 million based on an assumed ADA price of $0.20 and would finance Cardano's participation in 12 international conferences throughout 2027.
The proposed spending includes approximately $2 million for sponsorships, $1 million for exhibition infrastructure and $702,000 for travel support. Another $695,000 would finance accompanying events, including four hackathons.
The Foundation argued that coordinated participation in industry conferences gives Cardano developers access to businesses, investors and regulators they might otherwise struggle to reach.
It cited results from its previous events program, which generated 8,191 booth contacts, engaged 1,169 developers and initiated discussions around 219 potential collaborations between August 2025 and July 2026.
The program also supported 79 ecosystem projects and generated 1,045 Cardano wallet registrations, according to the Foundation.
However, the latest proposal highlights the distinction between attracting industry interest and establishing sustainable blockchain activity.
Its 2027 targets include 9,520 booth contacts, 955 developers, and 184 potential collaborations. While the Foundation also promises to track on-chain transactions generated through event contacts, the proposal sets no numerical target for that activity.
The organization has committed to publishing spending reports, monitoring performance through a public dashboard, and returning unused funds to the treasury.
The proposal also acknowledges financial risks associated with ADA's price. Should the token fall below the assumed $0.20 valuation, the Foundation says it would reduce or cancel planned activities rather than exceed its funding allocation.
The funding request is now before Cardano's delegated representatives, who have until Dec. 20 to vote on whether to approve the withdrawal.
Their decision will determine whether the Foundation secures another year of treasury-backed international outreach as it attempts to translate Cardano's technological progress into more measurable economic adoption.
items.title: Cardano faces $5 million adoption test after Hoskinson declares original roadmap complete

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
World Bank partners with Circle, Citi to explore stablecoins for payments
The initiative builds on the World Bank’s existing blockchain platform, which aims to create more fund traceability for investments in developing countries.
The World Bank Group said Tuesday it would explore using Circle’s USDC stablecoin to get money to borrowing countries faster and at a lower cost.
The group will work with Citi and Circle to see how payments in stablecoins tied to the US dollar could fit into the banking network it already uses to send money abroad, according to a press release.
Circle would provide the tools for USDC (USDC) issuance and transfers, while Citi would connect the project to existing banking networks. The group plans to start with borrowing countries that allow the use of digital assets.
The World Bank is a development bank owned by its member countries. It lends to governments in low- and middle-income countries and gives grants to some of the poorest, helping fund schools, health clinics and clean water systems.
The bank began rolling out blockchain tool FundsChain in 2025 to let project teams and auditors see where the money goes. The bank says the tool now covers more than 350 projects in 96 countries.
The World Bank in 2023 warned that widespread use of stablecoins could displace local money and make it harder for central banks to manage economies.
In June, CGAP, a research group based at the World Bank, examined using stablecoins to deliver humanitarian aid. The report found that stablecoins can make it easier for an aid agency to move money across borders. However, when recipients are paid directly in stablecoins, they may have to pay to convert them to local currency.

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，据印媒 Moneycontrol 报道，Polygon 联合创始人 Sandeep Nailwal 在接受采访时表示，Polygon 计划在未来 1 至 2 年内投入 5000 万至 1 亿美元，通过并购当地合规企业在新市场获取支付牌照，目标区域涵盖北美、欧盟、拉丁美洲（巴西、墨西哥）及东南亚。Polygon 下一步核心目标是取得美国银行牌照，成为面向大型机构提供跨境资金流转服务的全球代理行。

Nailwal 透露，继 2026 年 1 月以约 2.5 亿美元收购 Coinme 与 Sequence、成为美国持牌资金转移机构后，Polygon 目前正在推进对另一家北美公司的收购，并已向一家欧洲公司发出收购要约，以获取欧盟牌照。融资方面，Polygon 迄今累计融资约 4.5 亿美元，投资方包括软银愿景基金二期、Tiger Global 等，目前暂无迫切融资需求，最早可能 2027 年下半年或 2028 年初再考虑是否启动新一轮融资。

腾讯WorkBuddy日活超千万，日耗100万亿Token，带动云收入加速增长

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯公布 2026 年第三季度财报，营收 2073.36 亿元，同比增长 8%，经营利润却同比下降 7%。云服务成为增长最快的业务之一，收入同比增长 35%，较上季度 20% 出头的增速明显加快。

腾讯称，增长主要受到 WorkBuddy、模型服务和 GPU 租赁需求推动。截至 11 月初，WorkBuddy 日活跃用户超过 1000 万，每天合计消耗超过 100 万亿 Token。马化腾认为，按用户每日大模型 Token 消耗量计算，WorkBuddy 已是国内规模最大的 AI 应用。

WorkBuddy 目前已打通腾讯文档、腾讯会议、腾讯网盘等产品。用户授权后，AI 可以跨应用查找资料、处理文档和执行办公任务。腾讯还把混元 Hy4 首发接入 WorkBuddy，上线首日大量用户耗尽额度，随后进行了 10 倍扩容。

新推出的 Hy4 Flash 则进一步降低调用成本。腾讯内部评测显示，其完成同类任务的成本仅为 Hy4 的约 1/20。模型上线首日，全平台 Token 调用量突破 50 万亿，创混元系列新高。

不过，使用规模尚未完全转化为利润增长。腾讯第三季度调整后归母净利润为 665.19 亿元，同比下降 6%。公司仍未单独披露 WorkBuddy 的具体收入、付费率及整体盈利情况，外界暂时无法判断这款千万日活产品是否已经实现盈利。

items.content:
「半人马黑客」时代降临：GPT-6 Cyber仅花200美元挖出Java高危漏洞，美韩政府紧急应对，甲骨文火速修补

动察 Beating AI 快讯，网安公司 Calif 借助 OpenAI 的 GPT-6 Cyber，在 Java 底层发现严重漏洞 Java4Shell。研究人员称，只花 1 小时就找到漏洞，又用 2 小时开发出首个可用的攻击程序，AI Token 成本不到 200 美元。

Java 被全球约 90% 的财富 500 强企业使用，广泛运行在银行、政府、医院和大型互联网公司的后台系统中。Calif 已在符合漏洞条件的环境中，验证了 Keycloak、Jira、Confluence、Jenkins 等企业软件可以被远程攻破，其中多款无需登录。尤其是 Keycloak，它负责企业的身份认证和登录管理，一旦被攻破，还可能危及其他依赖它的业务系统。《纽约时报》拿到攻击验证材料后，也在不到 1 小时内独立复现了攻击。

漏洞藏在 Java 的 Base64 解码器中。这项功能广泛用于处理登录凭证、文件上传和网络通信数据。为了提高速度，Java 使用底层汇编代码处理这些数据，却留下了内存越界写入的漏洞。攻击者可以通过特殊构造的输入覆盖其他内存，进而窃取敏感数据，甚至控制服务器。Java 原本以较强的内存安全性著称，这次出问题的恰恰是绕过常规内存检查的底层加速代码。

Calif 上个月刚借助 AI 发现 PHP 的严重漏洞，这次又找到了 Java 的底层缺陷。披露前，团队已与美国、英国等「五眼联盟」成员国的相关政府部门，以及谷歌、微软等科技企业协调修复。美国网络安全和基础设施安全局（CISA）要求企业立即安装补丁，谷歌也确认已在旗下服务部署防护措施和修复程序。

韩国总统府国家安保室则于 11 月 17 日召集政府、军方和金融监管部门召开紧急会议。根据韩国政府统计，该国 15,618 个公共信息系统中，有 11,132 个使用 Java，占 71.28%。相关部门紧急排查 Java 使用情况，并协调安全更新。Oracle 已于同日发布补丁。

目前攻击仍有门槛，需要特定版本的 Java 和支持 AVX-512 VBMI 的处理器。不同软件也需要分别开发攻击方法。截至 11 月 17 日，Cisco 安全团队尚未观察到实际攻击活动。

Calif 团队把这种由顶级安全专家指导 AI 挖掘和利用漏洞的方式称为「半人马黑客」。CEO Thai Duong 向《纽约时报》表示，未来 AI 可能独立完成最复杂的网络攻击。

「我不知道我们还有多少时间，也许三个月，也许三年。但现在最强的黑客，就是半人马黑客。」

SOL comes out of Breakpoint 7% higher as Solana exits beta
Solana’s token reached $75.12 on Tuesday, outpacing Bitcoin and Ether after the network retired the beta label it had used since its 2020 launch.
Solana’s native token gained nearly 7% over the three days of the network’s Breakpoint conference in London, outperforming Bitcoin and Ether.
Solana (SOL) rose to $75.12 on Tuesday, up 6.95% from $70.24 at the end of Saturday, according to CoinGecko data. Bitcoin gained 1.2% and Ether rose 3.1% over the same period.
Breakpoint opened with a pre-conference event on Sunday, followed by the main program on Monday and Tuesday.
SOL’s price increase coincided with several announcements at Breakpoint, including a milestone in Solana’s network development and new institutional initiatives.
On Monday, the Solana Foundation announced that its Solana 1.0 designation has formally replaced the “mainnet beta” label used since the network’s 2020 launch. The change marks Solana’s move out of beta after six years, without affecting how users interact with the network.
Meanwhile, Project Harmonia named its first cohort of asset managers. The initiative, led by Allfunds Blockchain and the Solana Foundation, aims to distribute funds tokenized on Solana through Allfunds’ institutional network.
Other plans had been disclosed ahead of Breakpoint. The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation said Thursday it intends to connect its tokenization service to Solana in the second half of 2027.
Separately, Forward Industries announced a partnership with Groma to bring GromaCoin, a tokenized real estate asset, to Solana. Groma expects it to launch on the network in the first quarter of 2027.
Related: Solana Foundation takes majority interest in crypto data firm CoinGecko

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Monument’s Tokenised Saver mirrors a fixed-term deposit on Midnight, but customers cannot transfer or pledge the token record.
- Monument’s announced £250 million target is separate from an aggregate funded balance, which its reviewed bank pages do not disclose.
- Monument can pause tokenization without changing deposit terms, while future investment and lending products remain separate from the current saver.
Monument Bank’s Tokenised Saver records customers’ deposits on the Midnight blockchain, but savers cannot transfer the token, sell it to another customer, or pledge it to an outside lender.
In a Nov. 17 post, Charles Hoskinson celebrated the bank’s launch, quoting Midnight's congratulations to Monument and its partners:
“250 million pounds on-chain! That's some serious TVL.”
Monument’s March 27 announcement described a target of up to £250 million in client deposits, so the immediate test is what a customer can do with the record today. Monument’s blockchain record leaves withdrawal and collateral rights governed by the bank’s account terms.
The bank’s record on Midnight decides
The Tokenised Saver summary says the token mirrors the deposit, while Monument’s records remain the official account of the savings. If the two differ, the bank’s records apply, subject to correcting errors. Customers retain the right to query or challenge an error.
Neither the account nor its token record may be transferred, sold, or assigned, including to another Monument customer. Monument’s FAQ also says the bank owns and controls the wallet, so customers do not manage a private key or seed phrase.
The token record cannot be used as security, while the savings account can serve as security only in Monument’s favor, with the bank's written agreement. That leaves room for an agreed bank arrangement, but supplies no right to take the token to another lender.
Monument can also change, pause or stop the tokenization feature. Its summary warns that the record can be delayed, unavailable, or wrong, while saying the deposit, interest rate, interest, maturity date, and FSCS protection remain the same.
The bank deposit continues independently of whether its digital copy is functioning.
The product currently advertises a 12-month term at 5.2% annual equivalent rate, or 5.08% gross, with interest calculated daily and paid monthly. Interest can go to the customer’s linked account or back into the saver.
Eligibility is limited to existing Monument clients who are UK residents aged 18 or older. Accounts are held in one person’s name and require a personal UK bank account linked to the account.
Customers must hold at least £25,000 across Monument savings accounts, while the Tokenised Saver maximum is £100,000, excluding interest.
Customers have 14 days from account opening to fund the account and can cancel without penalty during that window. Otherwise, withdrawals and early closures are prohibited during the term, which begins with the first deposit.
Monument says eligible deposits are protected by the Financial Services Compensation Scheme up to £120,000 per person, aggregated across eligible deposits with the bank.
Lending needs its own terms
In March, Monument said deposits were the first phase and that it would explore tokenized investments and new lending options within its app afterward.
The current saver’s published terms do not provide an investment-backed lending facility. For investment-backed lending, the relevant terms would need to identify the collateral, establish the lender’s rights over it and explain how customers obtain spendable funds.
Customer-controlled transfers or external token collateral would also require rights and arrangements beyond this saver’s present restrictions.
For savers today, the concrete offer is fixed interest and an additional bank-controlled record, while future customer liquidity depends on new product rights and operating arrangements. Disclosure of the funded and tokenized balance would answer the separate question of the program’s scale.
items.title: Monument Bank puts £250M on Midnight, but hides strict bank rules

Arthur Hayes：FLOP矿工收益取决于推理需求，硬件配置需结合市场需求优化

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，Arthur Hayes 发文表示，近期许多个人及企业级 FLOP 矿工向其咨询硬件选择及性能优化方案，但他无法提供具体配置建议。FLOP 矿工的区块奖励取决于其处理的推理任务量，以浮点运算次数（FLOPs）衡量。例如，若某矿工在一个区块内处理了 100 GFLOPs 的推理任务，而全网总处理量为 200 GFLOPs，则该矿工可获得该区块 50% 的奖励。

Hayes 提醒，硬件性能并非决定矿工收益的唯一因素，市场对 AI 模型的实际需求同样重要。如果矿工部署的硬件支持某一 AI 模型，但该模型缺乏市场需求，设备将无法获得推理任务，也就无法产生收益。他建议矿工参考 OpenRouter 等平台的热门模型数据，预判 Agentic 任务的模型需求，并通过实际测试和收益表现不断调整硬件配置。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377977
items.title: Arthur Hayes：FLOP矿工收益取决于推理需求，硬件配置需结合市场需求优化

items.content:
Cloudflare开源Kitesurf：不用Chromium，内存占用最低仅七分之一

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Cloudflare 正式开源了专为 AI Agent 打造的浏览器引擎 Kitesurf。

Kitesurf 今年 8 月首次亮相。Cloudflare 认为，AI Agent 上网主要是读取和操作网页，用不上普通浏览器的许多功能。因此，Kitesurf 没有沿用 Chromium，而是利用现有开源技术重新搭建了一套轻量引擎，无需启动完整的浏览器。此前官方测试显示，它的 CPU 用量只有 Chromium 的约三分之一，内存最低约七分之一。

开发者可以把 Kitesurf 接入自己的 AI Agent，直接控制网页、执行脚本和截图，也能继续使用 Puppeteer 等现有工具。

Kitesurf 目前仍属于实验性项目，许多网页标准尚未完整支持，还不能全面替代 Chromium。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377975
items.title: Cloudflare开源Kitesurf：不用Chromium，内存占用最低仅七分之一

Bland推出Tofu-1：能听出电视在插话，AI客服还能边说边处理业务

动察 Beating AI 快讯，语音 AI 公司 Bland 发布新模型 Tofu-1，专门应对银行、医疗、保险等行业的复杂电话。它直接处理声音，能一边说话一边听，允许客户随时打断、纠正，还能区分客户、旁人和电视里的声音。

比如 AI 客服询问客户「确认取消保单吗？」客户还没回答，旁边的电视突然传出一声「是」。传统语音客服可能把这句话误认为客户同意。Tofu-1 则试图判断声音来源，避免误操作。

Tofu-1 还支持边交谈边处理请求。比如查询理赔进度时，AI 可以继续与客户交流，客户中途修改信息也能及时跟进。Bland 称，模型会等到任务真正完成后再报告结果。

目前 Tofu-1 仅开放企业研究预览申请，尚未公布延迟、识别准确率和业务任务成功率等实测数据。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Helen Partz
items.content:
Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase
Bitcoin ETF outflows returned after a one-day pause as CryptoQuant warned that Bitcoin had returned to a bearish market phase.
US spot Bitcoin exchange-traded funds (ETFs) resumed logging net outflows on Tuesday after a brief pause in the bleeding to start the week.
The funds recorded around $240 million in net outflows on Tuesday, with BlackRock’s iShares Bitcoin Trust (IBIT) accounting for $210 million, according to Farside Investors data.
IBIT had $76.5 million in net inflows on Monday, ending a $2.35 billion net outflow streak that spanned 11-straight sessions.
US spot Ether (ETH) ETFs also recorded net outflows of $29 million on Tuesday, adding to $8.3 million in withdrawals Monday. The ETH funds have seen net outflows in eight of the last nine trading sessions.
The renewed outflows in crypto ETFs came amid ongoing weakness in Bitcoin (BTC), which briefly dipped below $63,000 on Tuesday, according to CoinGecko.
Bitcoin has returned to a bearish phase amid weakening demand and mounting investor losses, CryptoQuant said in a Tuesday report shared with Cointelegraph. Its Bitcoin Analyst Consensus Index showed sentiment at its most bearish level since November 2025.
“Bitcoin needs demand growth in order to recover and rally sustainably,” CryptoQuant said, noting that total Bitcoin demand growth was contracting at its fastest pace since July 1.
Despite the bearish signals, CryptoQuant identified potential price support between $62,000 and $65,000 but cautioned that the indicators did not yet confirm a market bottom.
Related: Bitcoin drops 2.5% as Nvidia stock risks new 5-month lows into Q3 earnings
items.title: Bitcoin ETFs lose $240M as CryptoQuant flags bearish market phase

Axe Compute Q3营收环比增125%，客户预付款推高现金至1.48亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，据官方消息，Axe Compute（NASDAQ：AGPU）11 月 17 日披露，截至 9 月 30 日的 2026 年第三季度营收为 724 万美元，较第二季度的 322 万美元增长 125%。公司当季实现营业利润 683 万美元、净利润 1,150 万美元，摊薄后每股收益 0.52 美元。

现金方面，公司期末现金及等价物升至 1.477 亿美元，较二季度末的 2,190 万美元大幅增加；客户预付款形成的合同负债则从 6,080 万美元增至 5.693 亿美元。Axe Compute 表示，这些预付款主要用于支持其 GPU 基础设施采购：公司当季投入 3.496 亿美元采购 Build 项目所需集群设备。

业务扩张方面，公司称，年内已签署超过 30 亿美元总合同价值（TCV）的订单，全部部署后预计年化收入运行率将超过 7 亿美元。公司 9 月 30 日以 1.244 亿美元收购位于佐治亚州、配备 2,304 颗 NVIDIA B300 GPU 的集群，成为其首个自有集群；该项目正在等待客户验收，目标于第四季度投入运营，客户合同期限已延长至 2031 年。

公司同时完成出售 Helomics，正式转型为专注 GPU-as-a-Service 的单一业务公司。管理层未给出正式财务指引，仅表示佐治亚集群及 7 月签订的 Build 合同将自 2026 年第四季度起、并延续至 2027 年逐步部署。值得注意的是，Build 合同目前尚未确认收入，第三季度收入全部来自 Axe Compute Access 模式下的 GPU 算力服务。

Anthropic推出一键授权功能，Claude API告别手动填写密钥

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Anthropic 推出 Linked Billing（关联计费）功能，允许用户直接用自己的 Claude Platform 账户，为第三方 AI 工具支付 API 费用，无需再提供 API Key。目前处于 Beta 阶段，首批已有 19 款工具接入，包括 Factory、Linear、Warp、Ramp、Asana 等。

过去，用户想在第三方工具中使用自己的 Claude API，通常需要把 API Key 提供给平台。一旦密钥泄露，别人就可能盗用 API，产生的费用还得由用户承担。

现在，用户只需跳转到 Anthropic 官方页面，授权第三方工具使用自己的 API 额度。之后，费用由 Anthropic 直接收取。用户可以查看每个平台花了多少钱、设置消费上限，也能随时取消授权。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- A November preprint leaves Bitcoin's return toward its power-law trend unresolved, while its own forecasts assume that behavior.
- The study's slowing-growth finding disappears when its test allows shocks to persist beyond a random walk.
- Its 2027-2030 forecasts will test predictive performance, while the authors warn their uncertainty intervals are probably too narrow.
The power-law model links Bitcoin's price to its age, but the recovery forecasts in a Nov. 10 preprint also assume that departures from the long-run curve reverse, a tendency its historical analysis leaves unresolved.
Authors Carlos Baquero and Raquel Menezes argued that Bitcoin's long-run growth rate has slowed under the conditions their test allows.
The study's price record ends on Sept. 19, so its results do not explain November's selling.
Model advocate Stephen Perrenod made the attractor argument explicit in a June 5 analysis, arguing that tests of price deviations supported an attractor around which bubbles and bear markets occur.
He also cautioned that those tests did not predict next month's price or prove the relationship must continue indefinitely.
Reports on power-law likewise described an attractor framework while leaving the force sustaining it unsettled.
Baquero and Menezes used 820 weekly observations from January 2011 through September 2026. Within a declared family of possible price deviations, their test found evidence of a slowing long-run growth rate.
It rejected constant drift in expected log price at a nominal 5% significance level, compatible with a power-law trend, but does not identify it uniquely.
Their main family allowed shocks to persist as much as a random walk, where a shock need never fade. When a prespecified sensitivity check allowed even more persistent changes, the rejection disappeared, showing how the conclusion depended on the persistence assumption.
The paper also found that a Gompertz curve, which approaches a ceiling, described the historical record almost as well as the power law.
The recovery is built into the forecast
The authors said the fitted models for price deviations revert toward their trends, so most forecasts anticipate a rise from the approximately $81,000 September endpoint.
The restoring tendency entered through the chosen models even though the historical analysis cannot establish it within the evaluated approach.
For Dec. 28, 2030, the power-law model produced a $383,000 median and a 90% interval of $150,000 to $1,015,000. Across all five trend models, the medians ranged from $85,000 to $1,011,000.
The authors warned that their predictive intervals are probably too narrow and are not calibrated. Each forecast combines the fitted distribution with simulated and refitted alternatives, but the refits explore only neighboring choices for how deviations behave.
That leaves broader uncertainty about persistence only partly represented.
The result is a model that assumes a pull toward trend and cannot use its projected rebound as evidence that the pull exists.
The paper describes itself as a preregistered reanalysis of a record the authors had already studied. They reported freezing the protocol and posting its hash on Oct. 6, applying the historical test once on Oct. 7, then registering the results and forecasts later that morning.
Those forecasts target the last Saturday of each year from 2027 through 2030 and will be assessed jointly using a log-density score, which measures how well the predicted distributions match the eventual prices.
Better performance would demonstrate better prediction of those four observations. The distinction remains consequential for a Bitcoin recovery case: a historical growth curve can frame a forecast, but an assumed return toward it is still a proposition for future prices to test.
items.title: Bitcoin power-law models predict a rebound without real proof

items.content:
Bitunix分析师：主权债务风险重新定价，黄金短期承压、长期配置需求仍在

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，全球债券市场的焦点在于央行能否在财政压力下维持政策可信度。日本央行总裁植田和男重申，金融条件仍宽松，利率仍须随通膨逐步正常化；但日本第三季 GDP 年化萎缩 0.1%、民间消费下滑 0.3%，显示家庭购买力仍受物价侵蚀。植田支持审慎升息，却警告若紧急购债被视为替政府融资，反而可能放大长债波动。这揭示日本政策的核心矛盾：必须退出超宽松，却不能让财政融资取代货币政策目标。

美国债市面对的是相似的信任考验。10 年期公债殖利率近期升至 5.12%，富达国际认为，即使攀上 6%，也未必足以补偿通膨黏性、赤字扩大与股债相关性转变所带来的风险；当股票下跌时，公债未必仍能有效对沖，传统股债配置的分散效果因此受考验。日本央行不愿以购债替财政背书，富达则提醒美债高殖利率未必便宜，两者共同指向市场正在提高对主权债务与政策干预的风险溢酬。

黄金的走势则呈现短期与长期力量分歧：美元走强、升息预期升温，令金价今日下跌逾 1%，并触及一年多低点；但高盛仍预估央行购金可维持每月约 60 吨，支撑金价于 2027 年底回到每盎司 4,650 美元，若美联储于 2027 至 2028 年转向降息，2028 年底有望达 5,600 美元。相较之下，白银缺乏同等央行储备需求，较难复制流动性逼空行情。对 BTC 等风险资产而言，真正关键是高利率是否持续推升美元资金成本；若官方债务与货币信用风险升高，长期配置需求可能转向黄金，但不代表短期流动性压力会消失。

items.content:
Meta再失AI大将：思维链核心研究员出走，加盟200亿美元估值的Mercor

动察 Beating AI 快讯，顶尖 AI 研究员 Jason Wei 宣布离开 Meta 超级智能实验室 TBD Lab，加入数据初创公司 Mercor，担任首席科学家。他在 Meta 只待了一年左右。

Jason Wei 是大模型推理领域的代表性人物。他是经典「思维链」论文第一作者，推动了让大模型通过分步推理解决复杂问题的方法。在 OpenAI 期间，他参与研发 o1 推理模型和 Deep Research，还主导了 SimpleQA、BrowseComp 等重要评测，分别测试 AI 的事实准确性和深度搜索能力。

Mercor 原本是一家 AI 招聘平台，如今主要组织医生、律师、工程师等专业人士，为 AI 公司制作高质量训练数据和评测题目，帮助模型学习如何完成真实工作。

Mercor CEO Brendan Foody 透露，Jason Wei 过去几年一直是公司的客户和交流伙伴。如今，他将负责组建研究团队，领导数据与评测研究。团队里还有 LoRA 论文第一作者 Edward Hu，负责模型训练。

Mercor 刚在 11 月 10 日完成 7.5 亿美元 D 轮融资，估值达到 200 亿美元。公司正在从向大模型实验室供应数据，扩展到帮助更多企业训练、评测自己的 AI 模型。

Jason Wei 认为，随着越来越多企业开始训练模型，数据将决定 AI 下一阶段的发展方向。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Strong AI supervisors repeated forged answers after weaker helpers read the evidence in controlled tests.
- One Claude Code condition produced 75 wrong answers in 180 delegated trials, versus one in 180 direct-reading trials.
- Same-tier helpers and verification reduced failures in tested settings, whose fictional tasks do not measure customer failure rates.
A study submitted to arXiv on Nov. 12 found that stronger AI models could repeat forged answers when weaker helpers read the evidence, exposing a reliability risk in systems that split work across models.
In their November paper, researchers Keegan Wang and Anantika Mannby tested agents on fictional records and two-option questions.
They measured harmful revisions: adoption of the attacker's wrong answer against a correct baseline.
In one Anthropic's Claude Code test, an Opus 5 supervisor chose the planted wrong answer in 1 of 180 trials when reading files itself, compared with 75 of 180 when it delegated reading to Haiku 4.5. This stacked-forgery condition combined several forms of false evidence.
A separate OpenAI's Codex test used a forged annotation claiming authority, and GPT-5.6-sol made no harmful revisions in 180 direct-reading trials, versus 44 in 180 when it relied on GPT-5.6-terra. The Claude Code and Codex comparisons used different attacks, limiting comparisons between the products.
Delegated Claude Code trials mechanically limited the supervisor to its Task tool, removing direct file access, while Codex's delegation restriction was instructional and checked per trial.
The stacked attack placed five forged documents in a 35-file store, combining correction notices, an authoritative annotation and repeated false accounts. Detectable forgeries carried two clues: they predated the records they purported to correct and lacked genuine accession lines.
Instructions directed at automated readers were resisted wherever the researchers tested them. Some successful attacks instead looked like factual records, allowing a helper's report to carry a false conclusion upward.
Results also varied by attack: a correction-notice condition fooled Codex in 172 of 180 direct-reading trials.
Stronger readers and checking reduced errors
Using same-tier helpers reduced failures in the tested comparisons. Claude Code recorded no harmful revisions in 180 trials per condition under the annotation and stacked attacks, while Codex recorded 1 in 180 under the annotation attack.
Clean-store delegation also produced no harmful revisions in 180 trials for each product.
In one real-harness test with 40 trials per arm, requiring original-record quotations reduced harmful revisions from 15 to 3. A verifier told to be skeptical reduced them to 1.
The authors identify lost provenance and reduced checking as possible contributors. Their evidence about fewer tool turns is correlational, leaving suppressed verification as a hypothesis.
The experiments measure performance on generated fictional tasks in a sandbox. Their rates apply to the tested configurations, with variation across repeated runs, but they offer no estimate of ordinary customer failures.
The practical warning is that evaluating a supervisor alone can miss failures introduced by the model handling its evidence.
items.title: Frontier AI models adopt fake data, exposing a hidden flaw

腾讯Hy4 flash发布两天后开源，三个版本一次放出，旗舰Hy4还得等

动察 Beating AI 快讯，腾讯混元正式开源 Hy4 flash，距离模型发布仅过去两天。这次一次性放出三个版本的模型权重：

• Hy4 flash：经过指令微调的正式模型，可以直接用于对话、推理和智能体任务。

• Hy4 flash-FP8：8 位量化版本，主要用于降低模型部署时的显存占用。

• Hy4 flash Base：未经指令微调的预训练基础模型，方便开发者继续训练和定制。

Hy4 flash 总参数达 224B，每次推理激活 12B。即便经过 FP8 量化，部署门槛依然不低。腾讯已在 GitHub、Hugging Face、ModelScope 和 GitCode 开放下载，社区也制作了 GGUF 量化版本，方便在不同硬件环境下运行。

模型使用 Tencent Hy License，允许开发者按协议使用和修改权重，但附有许可条件。大型模型 API 服务商如果达到规定的营收或用户规模门槛，需要另行取得授权。

至于 770B 参数的旗舰 Hy4，腾讯表示仍在加速开源，目前没有公布具体时间。

Trade.xyz上ANT报价对应隐含估值约1.73万亿美元，相较招股书溢价24%

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，数据显示，Trade.xyz 上代表 Anthropic 上市前股权的永续合约 ANT 最新报价约为 96.7 美元。按这一价格推算，Anthropic 的完全摊薄估值约为 1.73 万亿美元。

据悉，Trade.xyz 上 ANT 的规则是 1 个 ANT 对应 Anthropic PBC 1 股 Class A 普通股的参考价格，以美元计价。Anthropic 在招股书中显示，其 IPO 发行价区间为每股 70—78 美元；若以区间上限 78 美元计算，公司完全摊薄估值约为 1.4 万亿美元。故以 Trade.xyz 上目前 ANT 报价 96.7 美元计算，相对官方招股书的 1.4 万亿美元约有 24% 溢价。

Gemini加码云端个人助手：Spark改名Tasks，免费开放并新增电话、购物功能

动察 Beating AI 快讯，Google 宣布将 Tasks 智能体模式向六个国家的免费用户开放，并升级至 Gemini 4 Hydrogen 模型。

Tasks 其实就是今年 5 月推出的 Gemini Spark。它原本需要付费订阅，能够在云端自主完成复杂任务、定时运行，即使关闭设备也能继续工作。10 月，Google 将 Spark 整合进 Gemini 主界面，改名为 Task，与普通 Chat 模式并列。

这次还新增了更多实际操作能力。Gemini 可以同时拨打多家商店的电话，询价、查库存、预约服务，并自动写入日历。购物时还能比价、找优惠券，通过 Google Pay 付款。用户可以设定消费上限，授权它登录网站，处理需要账号的事务。

Gemini 还接入了短信和邮件。用户可以直接发短信，或将邮件转发至 gemini@google.com，让它整理文件、安排日程、执行任务。这些工作都可以交给云端虚拟机处理，不必一直守在设备前。

Gemini 已经能连接 60 多款应用，涵盖邮件、日历、购物和支付。电话、支付、短信等新增功能目前从美国开始推出，部分网站仍需要用户接手完成操作。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377935
items.title: Gemini加码云端个人助手：Spark改名Tasks，免费开放并新增电话、购物功能

HSK Chain与Base Chain达成合作，连接亚洲与欧美链上生态，共建全球流动性

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，据官方消息，HashKey Group 旗下机构级区块链 HSK Chain 与 Base 达成合作，双方的合作将结合 HSK Chain 在亚洲高质链上资产与机构级链上金融领域的优势以及 Base 的全球链上生态，推动亚洲高质链上资产接入全球链上流动性。

HashKey On-Chain 将以 Base 作为核心链上网络。在保持 HSK Chain 独立运营的同时，双方将携手 Morpho 向符合资质的客户提供受许可制访问控制的 CeDeFi 借贷服务。HashKey Wallet 也将同步集成 Base 网络。此外，双方还将围绕现实世界资产（RWA）和稳定币展开技术合作，并将 Base 和 HSK Chain 作为 HashKey 代币化资产的默认发行网络，全面深化双链生态合作，具体合作细节以官方公布的正式文件为准。

官方表示，此次合作标志着 HSK Chain 与 Base 在连接亚洲高质链上资产与全球链上流动性方面迈出了重要一步。双方将充分发挥各自在高质链上资产与全球生态层面的核心优势，共同推动行业繁荣发展。

Base 是由 Coinbase 打造的区块链，致力于驱动全球链上经济。Base 专为交易、支付和 AI 智能体等场景设计，可在大规模运行下实现亚秒级结算，单笔交易成本不足一美分。目前，Base 是比特币和以太坊链上现货交易规模第一的平台，稳定币交易量位居各链前列，也是 AI 智能体支付的主要通道。作为开放、无需许可且兼容 EVM 的网络，Base 深受领先机构信赖，全球用户已达数百万。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377926

过去一周稳定币流通供应量再降31亿美元，反弹难续还是潜在底部？

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 18 日，据 DefiLlama 数据显示，过去一周，全球稳定币总流通供应量从 2,899.10 亿降至 2,867.65 亿，一周减少约 31.45 亿，降幅约 1.09%。

过去一个月，稳定币整体流通量出现了明显下降。根据 Glassnode 和 DefiLlama 等平台数据，过去约 30 天稳定币总供应减少了大约 140 亿至 170 亿美元，降幅为自 2022 年以来最大的一次。目前总规模大致回落到 2800 亿至 2900 亿美元附近，较今年 5 月的高点回落了约 7%。其中，USDT 和 USDC 的赎回贡献了绝大部分下降

Glassnode 认为，稳定币供应收缩意味着持有者正在将稳定币赎回成美元，把资金撤出市场，这会减少行情反弹的燃料。但若供应重新恢复增长，将是新资金重新流入的首个信号。

CryptoQuant 则表示，本次稳定币供应降幅超过 2022 年 FTX 事件后的同期水平，比特币可能在 USDT 供应重新转正之前先形成局部底部。

items.author: Liam 'Akiba' Wright
items.content:
Quick Take
- Binance’s Anthropic reset rules cancel take-profit and stop-loss orders, even when ordinary positions are reinstated.
- Grid, DCA and Snowball bot positions close without reinstatement, regardless of the close-on-stop setting.
- Isolated positions are funded at the original leverage’s initial-margin requirement, limited by available Cross Margin balances.
Binance’s Nov. 17 rules for resetting its Anthropic pre-IPO perpetual contract call for canceling existing protective orders and closing bot positions without restoring them.
Under the exchange's reset rules, ordinary positions are reinstated with revised sizing, leaving holders with different consequences depending on how they traded.
The reset changes the contract’s estimated share-count basis from 1 billion to 13,116,075,288, with Binance specifying an adjustment factor of 13.116. These perpetual contracts provide exposure to Anthropic’s price without ownership of the underlying shares.
The exchange’s early-completion notice set the adjustment and rename from ANTHROPICUSDT to ANTUSDT for 10:25 UTC, with continuous trading at 10:30 UTC after a cancel-only phase.
Under Binance’s adjustment procedure, an increase in the share-count basis raises position quantity. Because the procedure preserves position notional value, it implies a proportionally lower mark price, subject to minor rounding as prices and quantities align with permitted increments.
The process also closes ordinary positions, settles unrealized profit or loss into the Cross Margin Futures Account, and resets the reinstated position’s average entry price to the adjusted mark. Profit or loss previously displayed as unrealized becomes settled account balance.
All open orders are canceled, including reduce-only take-profit and stop-loss orders, so restoring a position does not restore its old protective instructions. Holders who want equivalent protection need to place new orders suited to the adjusted position.
Binance said Grid, DCA, and Snowball bots would terminate at 08:15 UTC on Nov. 17, closing their positions regardless of the close-on-stop setting.
Isolated margin is rebuilt
The rules move realized profit or loss for isolated positions and the entire isolated margin balance back to Cross Margin. The system then funds the reinstated isolated position according to the initial-margin requirement for the leverage selected before the adjustment.
If the available Cross Margin balance falls below the required initial margin, Binance says the system transfers only the available balance.
The exchange urged holders to reassess collateral and positions in both Cross Margin and Isolated Margin accounts after the adjustment, warning that insufficient maintenance margin or price fluctuations could trigger liquidation.
items.title: Binance resets Anthropic futures, wiping out stop-loss orders

谷歌旗下AI制药公司Isomorphic Labs半年融资71亿美元，首批AI药物仍未进入人体试验

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌母公司 Alphabet 旗下 AI 制药公司 Isomorphic Labs 宣布完成 50 亿美元 C 轮融资，由 Greenoaks 和红杉资本联合领投，a16z 等机构参与，Alphabet 继续投资。

Isomorphic Labs 今年 5 月刚完成 21 亿美元 B 轮融资。短短半年，两轮融资合计达到 71 亿美元。

公司由诺贝尔奖得主、Google DeepMind 联合创始人 Demis Hassabis 领导，核心技术是 AI 药物设计系统 IsoDDE。它利用 AI 预测分子结构、相互作用和药物性质，帮助研究人员设计、筛选和优化新药。

Isomorphic Labs 称，目前有超过 20 个药物研发项目正在推进，癌症和免疫疾病方向已取得积极的临床前结果，但尚无自研药物进入人体试验。Hassabis 今年 1 月曾预计，首批药物将在 2026 年底前启动临床试验。

不过，他此次接受彭博社采访时没有更新这一时间表，只表示监管申报仍按计划推进，2027 年将有更多消息。本轮融资也将用于扩大药物研发规模，为后续临床试验做准备。

--- Top Comments ---

[tristanj]: It's pretty obvious that Gemini 4 Carbon is not token efficient. It also has relatively low tokens-per-second compared to other models. I can think of several reasons why this is the case: 1. Google has huge amounts of cash and compute. Their goal was to train a model that that has the highest quality & frontier performance, not create a model that's efficient to run and serve. They have other models for that, like Hydrogen. 2. Google created Carbon without caring for inference ...

[horacemorace]: I was just using this one today for some coding tinkering and it was super slow. But the way it solves problems with a light touch while still driving toward sensible architecture is refreshing after claude’s bulldozer attitude. It was able to integrate repeated creeping scope nicely with what it had already done. Very different feel than sonnet/opus, and even gemini 3.8.

[seizethecheese]: We have only 146 battles [1] with Carbon, so I kicked off an analysis with skepticism we'd have anything to add here. I was wrong. Carbon is that slow. The main causes seem to be: - Time to complete: 6m 08s for Carbon vs 2m 04s for opponents. - Output tokens 16.4k for Carbon vs 6.8k for opponents. - Tool calls: 21 for Carbon vs 11 for opponents. All three of these are statistically significant. The ones that don't seem to be a huge issue, but have been mentioned here or in the blog ...

[hetspookjee]: Might be the only one in the thread but ever since Gemini 4 Argon. I’ve become a huge fan of the Google models. I do use Carbon most of the time since it’s become available but notice that i  also am falling back more and more on Argon again without much difference. For security purposes argon has far fewer triggers. 
I only use the Google models as orchestrator for how they talk and analyse.  I let it delegate everything to Astra / Fable / Opus models

[jedbrooke]: I noticed a similar issue going from Opus 4.6 to 5.5. I also however upgraded my harness during that time, and I found out that it was injecting something like “Be helpful, read in between the lines and proactively go beyond the user’s request” at each turn. I immediately patched that out and saw decent improvement in that area. TFA mentions they tried different harnesses though, so yeah it’s prob baked in to whatever RL setup they’re using to train the original model. This is why I feel like...

items.content:
90后华人创办的Genesis AI再融5亿美元，英伟达、AMD参投

动察 Beating AI 快讯，华人机器人科学家周衔创立的 Genesis AI 宣布完成 5 亿美元 A 轮融资，投后估值达到 35 亿美元。Khosla Ventures、Premji Invest 和 Eclipse 联合领投，英伟达、AMD 等参与投资。公司去年 7 月才完成 1.05 亿美元种子轮融资。

Genesis AI 的核心目标是让机器人学会像人一样使用双手。它开发了一套特殊的传感手套，让工人在正常工作时佩戴，记录手指动作、接触力度和第一视角画面。机器人手部与人手的结构和尺寸高度接近，能够直接学习这些数据。目前已有全球 100 多名工人参与采集，数据用于训练机器人模型 GENE，再通过 Genesis World 仿真系统进行大规模练习。

Genesis 此前展示过机器人切番茄、打鸡蛋、弹钢琴等操作。TechCrunch 记者这次实地探访时，还看到机械臂完成了扫码、装箱、封箱和贴标签的整套流程。但第二次演示就出了岔子：机器人弄掉了盒子，撕取标签时也遇到困难。

现场演示的还不是 Genesis 的旗舰机器人 Eno。Eno 采用双臂和轮式底盘设计，周衔称它的能力更强，但当天并未向记者展示实际操作。

目前，Genesis 只造出了 30 至 40 台 Eno，正在少数客户中试用，计划明年在美国启动规模化生产。硬件耐用性仍是个问题：现有灵巧手在日常使用几周后就需要更换。公司打算先进入制造业、物流和实验室，再逐步拓展到家庭等场景。
