德国联邦议院通过法案，海关可在未立案前冻结超10万欧元来源不明加密资产

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据 CoinDesk 报道，德国联邦议院已于 11 月 12 日通过一项立法，允许海关在对资产合法来源存在合理怀疑时，无需先提起刑事案件，即可冻结价值超过 10 万欧元（约 11.6 万美元）的加密货币及其他资产。该措施针对来源不明的高价值资产，并不限于加密货币，并明确涵盖欧盟《加密资产市场法规》（MiCA）所覆盖的加密货币。法案仍须获得联邦参议院批准，计划于 2027 年 1 月 1 日实施。

德国联邦律师协会（BRAK）反对该措施，认为其给当局质疑资产取得方式留下过大空间，并警告不应将包括继承财产在内的文件缺失，视为资产来自非法活动的证据。德国律师协会（DAV）同样反对，称当局可在资产合法来源显得「并不合理」时介入，并批评扩大海关权力、将警察职能转移给海关。监管咨询机构 Global Policy 创始人 Andrew Withworth 对 CoinDesk 表示，对加密资产持有者而言，实践中的问题是何为合法来源的证明，这属于德国财政法院而非欧盟加密监管的范畴。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377639

英国前首相约翰逊在Breakpoint重申对比特币的怀疑态度

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，英国前首相鲍里斯·约翰逊在伦敦举行的 Solana Breakpoint 大会上重申对比特币的怀疑态度。他表示，就他所见，「除了 Yakimoto Nakasori，没有人知道谁在负责，而我也不知道去哪里找他」，并刻意说错了比特币匿名创始人中本聪的名字。约翰逊还称，如果有某种加密货币被盗走 60 亿，「我不知道该向谁申请，也不知道如何把钱拿回来，这就是我的问题。」他今年 3 月曾在《每日邮报》撰文，将比特币称为「巨大的庞氏骗局」，随后遭到包括 Strategy 执行主席 Michael Saylor 在内的加密行业人士反驳。Saylor 当时指出，庞氏骗局需要中心化运营方承诺回报并用后来者资金兑付先来者，而比特币没有发行方、推销方，也没有保证回报。

约翰逊同时将比特币与其背后的技术区分开来。他表示，不要以为他「对加密的卢德式焦虑」意味着希望放缓区块链发展，或放缓伦敦在这类技术上本应拥有的领先地位，并称在区块链和资产代币化方面，英国「必须走在最前列」。主持人、The Block 多媒体负责人 Gareth Jenkinson 反驳了约翰逊关于比特币对毒贩有价值的说法，称区块链比现金更容易追踪，并表示「没有人必须担保它，这正是该协议的美妙之处。」

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson told Solana's Breakpoint conference in London that he remains skeptical of Bitcoin, asking who guarantees it and who is in charge.
- Johnson said his doubts don't extend to blockchain, saying London should lead in the technology and in tokenizing assets.
- Lord Ross Kempsell, a Conservative peer and former Johnson aide, said the UK's coming crypto rules leave room for a "high growth industry."
Former UK Prime Minister Boris Johnson is sticking to his doubts about Bitcoin, telling a room full of crypto developers that he still can't see who is in charge of the world's largest cryptocurrency.
"As far as I can see, nobody knows who's in charge, apart from Yakimoto Nakasori, and I don't know where to find him," Johnson said at Solana's Breakpoint conference in London, deliberately mangling the name of Bitcoin's pseudonymous creator, Satoshi Nakamoto. "If six billion got stolen from some cryptocurrency, I wouldn't know who to apply to, or how to get the money back. That's my problem."
Johnson was asked about a column he wrote in March for the Daily Mail, in which he called Bitcoin a "giant Ponzi scheme." The column drew pushback from the crypto industry, including Strategy executive chairman Michael Saylor, who tweeted that Bitcoin has no issuer, promoter or guaranteed return.
Bitcoin is not a Ponzi scheme. A Ponzi requires a central operator promising returns and paying early investors with funds from later ones. Bitcoin has no issuer, no promoter, and no guaranteed return—just an open, decentralized monetary network driven by code and market demand.
— Michael Saylor (@saylor) March 13, 2026
On stage, Johnson admitted he is "not a great crypto buff" and holds little, if any, crypto himself. His view was shaped by a man he met in his Oxfordshire village who had lost thousands and kept paying more in the hope of recovering his losses, he said. "If the search for the greater fool had reached the wilds of South Oxfordshire, then probably there was something not quite right about this thing," Johnson said.
He also questioned the name itself, noting that "crypto" comes from the Greek for "hidden." "I don't think it's a good sell to tell people that this thing is concealed," he said.
'Luddite anxiety'
Johnson drew a sharp line between Bitcoin and the technology behind it. "Please don't think that my Luddite anxiety about crypto in any way means that I wish to slow down the development of blockchain, or the lead that London should rightly have in that sort of technology," he said. When it comes to blockchain and tokenizing assets, the UK has "got to be at the forefront," he added.
Moderator Gareth Jenkinson, head of multimedia at The Block, pushed back when Johnson suggested Bitcoin was valuable to drug dealers, arguing that blockchains are far more traceable than cash. Asked by Johnson who guarantees Bitcoin, Jenkinson replied: "No one has to guarantee it. That's the beauty of the protocol."
Regulation on the way
Lord Ross Kempsell, a Conservative member of the House of Lords who previously worked for Johnson, said more than 8% of UK adults now hold some form of crypto asset, and that institutional adoption of blockchains is growing in the City of London. That ownership figure has fallen, however: the Financial Conduct Authority's latest consumer research, conducted in August and September 2025, found 8% of UK adults own crypto, down from 12% in 2024, though still double the level in 2021.
The UK is "on the precipice of creating a lot of regulation" for the sector, Kempsell said, pointing to the FCA's work on its regulatory perimeter and the Bank of England's coming stablecoin framework. "I share Boris's anxieties about the risks," he said, but within that perimeter, "there's a lot of scope here for a high growth industry."
In June, the FCA finalized its rulebook for crypto firms ahead of a mandatory regime due to take effect in late 2027, days after the Bank of England eased its stablecoin rules, scrapping planned individual holding caps in favor of a £40 billion issuance limit per coin. The Bank has since been handed a legal duty to foster stablecoin innovation, and it has set out a shared vision for tokenization with the FCA.
Kempsell also argued that being outside the EU's Markets in Crypto-Assets (MiCA) regulation allows the UK to set its own rules for crypto. The EU itself is set to revise MiCA in 2027 to cover foreign stablecoin issuers.

items.author: Cointelegraph by Isabelle Castro
items.content:
Zelle picks Solana for ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments
Zelle plans to use Solana for its ZelleUSD stablecoin and international payments, with confidential transfers designed to hide payment amounts.
Zelle, the US peer-to-peer payments network operated by Early Warning Services (EWS), a consortium of banks that includes JPMorgan and Wells Fargo, is partnering with Solana to support its expansion into international payments. The company announced on stage at Breakpoint 2026 that its proprietary dollar-backed stablecoin, ZelleUSD (ZLUSD), will launch on the Solana blockchain to allow for peer-to-peer payments internationally.
The move brings one of the largest domestic payments networks in the US into the blockchain-based payments market. Zelle processed more than $1.2 trillion in US payments in 2025 and has since taken steps to establish an international business. In June, the company named India as its first international remittance corridor, with plans to allow US consumers to send money to friends and family in the country. In the same announcement, the company unveiled ZelleUSD, intended to underpin future international payment capabilities in additional markets. ZelleUSD’s issuer is Anchorage Digital Bank.
“Sending money around the world is a pain; it’s complex, it’s fragmented and it’s often unfamiliar. Over half of the Remittance services that are offered today don’t deliver money as fast as we’d like them to,” said Alexandra Lang, vice president of digital asset partnerships at Zelle. “Solana is a partner we chose because we’re here to deliver payments at scale.”
The collaboration will also include ongoing experimentation into the development of privacy features for the transactions, aimed at preserving the sensitivity of payments on the public blockchain.
Zelle cites Solana’s network reliability
For Zelle, the decision to select Solana appears to have been driven in large part by the network’s infrastructure. “Zelle has such a massive scale in the United States, we needed a partner that can also deliver at massive scale internationally as well,” said Denise Leonhard, General Manager at Zelle in a video discussing the partnership.
“The number one priority is the responsibility that we have to make sure that payments are safe, secure, and they get to the right place [...] That piece around trust, security, proven infrastructure is the reason why we chose Solana.”
Following several years in which network outages raised questions about Solana’s suitability for financial applications, the chain has maintained 100% uptime since February 2024. This is despite a routing failure at infrastructure provider Teraswitch in August 2026, which took 29% of Solana’s network offline. According to blockchain intelligence platform Metrika, transaction finality slowed, but uptime was sustained.
On stage at Breakpoint 2026, the Solana Foundation announced the migration of Solana from beta into mainnet, bringing with it an improvement in finality speed from 13 seconds to 150 milliseconds.
Related: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
Confidential transfers shield payment amounts
Going deeper into what the collaboration will entail, on stage at Breakpoint, Lang introduced the confidential payments features the two companies had developed. She explained that the privacy focus aimed at balancing customer privacy over their payments on the network with the money laundering checks large institutions are required to make.
In the payments wallet, customers will have the option to encrypt their transfer so it is shielded from the public blockchain. Institutions that are part of Zelle’s network will be able to decrypt the transfer to carry out the checks needed to maintain compliance.
“Features like this are paramount to really getting payments to scale,” said Lang.
Related: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
Solana competes with Ethereum and Tron for remittance play
Although Solana is gaining ground in stablecoin activity, Ethereum and Tron continue to hold substantially larger pools of dollar-pegged assets. According to Token Terminal data pulled on Nov. 14, Ethereum held $150.5 billion in stablecoins while Tron held $93.2 billion, compared with $13.9 billion on Solana.
However, Solana’s stablecoin activity is growing faster in transaction frequency than on either of its larger competitors. The network recorded an 82% increase in monthly stablecoin transfers year-over-year in October, compared with 48% growth on Ethereum, while Tron’s transfer count declined by nearly 8%, according to Token Terminal data.
Zelle’s choice of Solana over both Tron and Ethereum follows other remittance providers that have expanded on-chain. Also at Breakpoint, MoneyGram outlined an integration with Solflare allowing Solflare wallet users to exchange UDSC to cash. The move expands MoneyGram Ramps on Solana, launched by the company in August.
“That’s where MoneyGram brings something different to the ecosystem: the ability to bridge digital dollars and physical cash at scale, making stablecoins more useful in everyday life,” said Luke Tuttle, Chief Product and Technology Officer at MoneyGram in a press release.
While Zelle did not provide a timeline for the launch of international payments on stage, earlier announcements indicated that the India corridor would be live by the end of 2026.

items.content:
Four days before an L3Harris router upgrade grounded America’s flights in the first extended nationwide ground stop since September 11, 2001, L3Harris’ former CEO was selling millions of dollars worth of stock.
Christopher Kubasik’s November 9 disclosure of $4 million worth of sales was his seventh in two months, lifting his total cash-out to more than $21 million as he dumped a cumulative 89,980 shares of LHX, the company’s NYSE-listed common stock.
Kubasik ran the giant defense contractor as CEO from June 2021 until August 2026. His large insider sales began September 10, after his exit as chairman.
On November 10, three days before L3Harris’ router caused a nationwide ground stop, he filed notice to sell 20,000 more shares, worth about $5.5 million, through Goldman Sachs.
Nothing in the record suggests Kubasik knew L3Harris’ router was about to strand hundreds of thousands of travelers. The timing did the talking.
His post-exit sales never appeared as Form 4 transactions. They surface only in the quieter Rule 144 notices, so screens that track Form 4s missed the pattern of sales.
L3Harris caused the US nationwide ground stop
On November 13 at about 3:30 p.m. ET, a data flood hit the US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) telecom network. It ran overly fast at 1,000 attempted connections every four to five seconds, per the FAA, overloading communication centers.
Approximately 3,500 planes were forced to land and operators canceled approximately 12,462 flights that day.
The trail ran through two potential locations: a radar facility in Amarillo, Texas, and a radio site in El Dorado, Arkansas. L3Harris, the network’s service provider, had been deploying a new router at the El Dorado site.
Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy told reporters the FAA was investigating “whether we had incompetence, meaning was it user error or install error from L3Harris or did they install a faulty router.”
The man who ran the network’s parent company had already left the building.
L3Harris ousted Kubasik as chairman and CEO on August 16. An independent-counsel probe found conduct “not consistent with the values of the company as outlined in its code of conduct.”
Read more: MongoDB CEO quits to join Meta, stock crashes $6 billion behind him
Semafor reported allegations of a relationship involving a subordinate, which a spokesperson for Kubasik denied.
In 2012, a separate ethics investigation confirmed Kubasik having a close personal relationship with a subordinate, and Kubasik resigned as Lockheed Martin’s incoming CEO at that time.
“I regret that my conduct in this matter did not meet the standards to which I have always held myself,” he said in 2012.
L3Harris shares slid about 4% in after-hours trading on Friday as the outage began.

Cypherpunk Q3财报：持有约34.19万枚ZEC，净利润约3.06亿美元

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Zcash 财库公司 Cypherpunk Technologies（纳斯达克：CYPH）发布 2026 年第三季度财报。截至报告日，公司持有 341,858.75 枚 ZEC，约占 ZEC 流通量的 2.01%，目标为长期持有至少 5%；季度结束后，公司以均价约 920.40 美元增持 3775.72 枚 ZEC，合计约 347.5 万美元。

截至 9 月 30 日，其所持 ZEC 公允价值约 4.701 亿美元。财务方面，Cypherpunk 第三季度挖矿收入约 991 万美元，为 8 月 18 日至 9 月 30 日挖出的 8967.29 枚 ZEC；净利润约 3.06 亿美元，主要来自 ZEC 价格由 6 月 30 日的 400.09 美元升至 9 月 30 日的 1414.56 美元所带来的约 3.31 亿美元非现金嵌入式衍生工具公允价值收益，部分被约 2750 万美元所得税拨备抵消。截至 9 月 30 日，公司现金及现金等价物约 5599 万美元。

运营方面，Cypherpunk 矿场算力约 4.2 GSol/s，截至 11 月 13 日约占 Zcash 全网算力的 13.1%，10 月挖出 5721.35 枚 ZEC。公司已与比特大陆签署意向书，拟采购最高 3000 万美元的下一代 Zcash 矿机，预计 2027 年年中交付，目标将算力占比提升至全网约 25%。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377626

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys
Lighter restored withdrawals after recovering approximately $5 million in USDC, while blockchain analysts traced $10.4 million in funds moved during the exploit.
Update 20:40 UTC: This article has been updated with details of Lighter’s $5 million fund recovery, the restoration of withdrawals and the cause of the exploit.
Decentralized derivatives exchange Lighter said it had restored withdrawals and recovered approximately $5 million after an attacker exploited compromised trader API keys in an incident involving more than $10 million in withdrawals Monday.
Blockchain analytics firm Bubblemaps said about $10.4 million in USDC had been withdrawn from the platform. It tracked funds being swapped into Ether (ETH) and Wrapped Monero XMR1, a token traded on Hyperliquid.
Lighter initially said its protocol and smart contracts were unaffected. The exchange activated Guardian mode, temporarily pausing withdrawals and new pool creation while its Security Council worked to secure the platform.
The security incident follows a string of high-profile cryptocurrency exploits this year, including the $6.3 billion Binance hack on Oct. 29, the industry’s largest to date.
Lighter and Bubblemaps identified wallet ‘0xb3f’ as the attacker’s address. Blockchain data platform Bitquery separately traced 10,393,057 USDC leaving Lighter’s Ethereum contract at 10:11 am UTC. It said most of those funds were converted into Ether through CoW Swap within minutes, followed by a series of 160 ETH transfers to wallets linked to XMR1 purchases on Hyperliquid.
Related: DOJ moves to seize $1.2B from Binance hack, disrupts FaceStealer scam
Bitquery expands tracing to 12 Hyperliquid accounts
In subsequent analysis, Bitquery identified a total of 1,920 ETH transferred through 12 wallets, each receiving 160 ETH (about $290,000) before routing the funds through LI.FI toward Hyperliquid.
The 12 Hyperliquid accounts purchased approximately $3.46 million in XMR1 tokens. Another 3,845 ETH, worth about $7 million, remained in the original wallet as of 11:55 UTC on Monday, according to Bitquery’s latest snapshot.
Bitquery also identified similar fund movements following a separate $6.45 million Safe wallet theft at 11:35 UTC on Monday, about 84 minutes after the Lighter withdrawal, as well as a Kava exploit two days earlier.
All three involved funds routed through LI.FI into XMR1 purchases on Hyperliquid, but Bitquery found no direct transfers linking either of the other incidents to Lighter. The firm cautioned that similar transaction routes alone are weak evidence of a common attacker.
Lighter restores withdrawals, recovers $5 million
In a postmortem published Monday at 18:20 UTC, Lighter detailed how the attacker obtained private API keys through a trader’s custom signing software, which reused cryptographic nonces, allowing the keys to be calculated from publicly available signatures.
The attacker used the compromised keys to create a public pool, transfer funds into it and withdraw them through an attacker-controlled account.
Lighter said its Guardian security mechanism temporarily paused withdrawals, allowing its Security Council to return approximately $5 million in USDC to the affected trader. The exchange said its protocol, smart contracts and official software development kits were unaffected.
Lighter has since required wallet signatures for transfers to public pools and made API-key signatures non-public. It also plans to introduce IP allowlists and configurable permissions for API keys.
Additional reporting by Nate Kostar.
Magazine: Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
items.title: Lighter recovers $5M after $10M exploit linked to compromised API keys

items.author: Aaron Wise
items.content:
A wallet tied to Rune Christensen, the founder of DAI stablecoin protocol Maker and its USDS successor Sky, borrowed $1 million against SKY tokens on October 26, less than a week before his game studio, Raw Power Games, went bankrupt.
All told, that wallet has withdrawn and owes over $76 million to a Sky savings pool that has effectively locked out ordinary depositors from withdrawing. On Sunday, available liquidity from the pool was as good as $0.
That single wallet’s outstanding loans account for roughly half of the pool’s loans.
A critic on social media assumes much of the stablecoin loans went to Raw Power.
Protos has been unable to independently verify the quantity of money borrowed from Sky or Sky-based stablecoin liquidity pools, such as staked USDS, that benefitted Raw Power. However, Christensen’s overwhelming control of Sky Protocol and its wallets is widely suspected.
Even a formal rating by S&P last month notes Christensen’s “highly centralized” role where “he effectively influences key decisions.”
Protos has covered Christensen’s preeminent power at Maker (now Sky) since 2022.
Raw Power goes bankrupt, shares same founder as USDS
On October 30, Christensen’s gaming studio admitted, “Due to circumstances outside our control, the necessary funding behind Raw Power Games is no longer in place.”
Although the admission didn’t name the financial backer, Danish media outlet Ingeniøren reported in 2022 that Christensen founded the studio with his own money.
Company records show Christensen stepped down as a corporate director around October 29, 2026 — the same week a liquidator was appointed over the company.
Two weeks later, another gaming company called Coffee Stain agreed to a 36.75 million Danish kroner (US$5.4 million) purchase of Raw Power Games’ intellectual property out of its “bankruptcy estate.”
Announced this weekend, Coffee Stain expects finalization of that deal within “weeks.”
Read more: Maker DAO drama flares amid proposal to tackle ‘governance attack’
USDS liquidity pool with $0 of available liquidity
Before borrowing limits crashed to $0, the wallet borrowed tens of millions of dollars worth of USDS assets, including $1 million within a week of Raw Power going bankrupt.
The pool is for staked USDS, where stablecoin savers can lend Sky’s dollar stablecoin to borrowers who post SKY tokens as collateral. The pool currently incentivizes deposits with a 13.6% annualized interest rate.
Borrowers have taken nearly all of the available USDS, however. An analyst correctly described, “even its biggest holders can’t take out a single dollar right now.”
On-chain records show withdrawable cash effectively ran out on Halloween, within days of the studio’s bankruptcy.
The wallet owed more than $72 million by April and has made no repayments on its loans, so interest accumulation kept pushing its total loan balance higher. By October 28, its outstanding balance was $76.6 million.
Sky is the renamed MakerDAO. As Protos reported in 2024, the project has issued the DAI stablecoin since December 2017, and introduced one-for-one conversion of DAI into USDS.
It also introduced a new governance token, SKY, to replace Maker’s old governance token, MKR.
Withdrawals from the pool depend on loan repayments or new money arriving from fresh depositors. The largest borrower is a wallet tied to the founder of USDS, whose gaming company just went bankrupt.

OpenAI计划以至少50亿美元价格收购GoodFire

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据市场消息，OpenAI 计划以至少 50 亿美元的价格收购 GoodFire。

GoodFire（通常写作 Goodfire）是一家专注于机制可解释性（Mechanistic Interpretability）的 AI 研究实验室，核心目标是为大模型做「脑部扫描」，打开 AI 的「黑箱」，让模型的内部决策过程变得可理解、可调试、可控制。它由来自 OpenAI 和 Google DeepMind 可解释性团队的研究人员于 2024 年创立，团队成员大多来自这两家前沿实验室及顶尖高校。其核心技术平台（如 Silico 和 Ember）能让开发者深入模型内部，观察神经元和通路的活动，甚至在训练过程中直接调整参数来改变模型行为，例如已经实现了将大模型幻觉减少一半。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377621

Kamino推出三项全新应用、自研交易执行算法Kamino ONE及面向机构的自动化平台Omni

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Solana 信贷协议 Kamino 在 Solana Breakpoint 2026 宣布推出三项产品：全面重建的 Kamino 应用、自研交易执行算法 Kamino ONE，以及面向机构的自动化投资组合平台 Kamino Omni。Kamino 首席执行官 Michael Weisz 表示，公司希望让机构、基金和用户发现并购买资产、以此借款，并从其已持有的资产中获得收益与用途。

全新应用已上线，官方称完成逾 200 项性能改进。新增 Assets Hub 可发现并购买逾 100 种现实世界资产，符合条件者可用作抵押或开设 Multiply 仓位；用户可一次完成存入抵押并借款，查看整个投资组合的借款能力并模拟价格波动，止盈止损自动化计划于 2027 年开始推出。面向部分用户的 Kamino Account 亦开始开放，完整版本目标于 2027 年发布，将支持美元、欧元和英镑银行出入金等功能。Kamino ONE 是 Kamino Swap 的执行算法，可在 16 家聚合器、80 多个交易场所持续比价至成交，并已首先接入 Figure 的 Hastra 平台，支持直接铸造和赎回 AUTO 与 PRIME。官方称，Kamino Swap 自 2025 年上线元聚合以来成交量已超过 50 亿美元，服务逾 5 万名用户。

Kamino Omni 面向资产管理人等机构，用于构建、管理、代币化并分发链上自动化投资组合，组合代币按实时净资产价值定价，可用作抵押，并可配置 KYC、KYB 和白名单。官方称该平台代码已完成、已通过三轮审计并仍在接受审计，首批试点投资组合目标于 2027 年一季度推出。Kamino 称累计交易量超过 8150 亿美元，累计放贷超过 210 亿美元，未出现坏账。

贝莱德申请推出新型ETIF基金，拟突破私营企业资产15%投资比例限制

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，彭博 ETF 分析师 Eric Balchunas 在社交媒体上发文表示，贝莱德（BlackRock）近期提交了一项新型基金结构申请，名为交易所交易区间基金（Exchange Traded Interval Fund，ETIF）。该结构拟允许基金投资私营企业资产的比例超过传统基金常见的 15% 限制，同时保留类似 ETF 的交易所上市交易及持仓透明度。

与普通 ETF 不同，ETIF 拟采用每月一次的赎回机制，以适应私营企业股权等流动性较低的投资标的。目前，该基金结构仍处于申请阶段，具体监管安排及获批情况尚待确认。

西联汇款数字资产网络已开放接入，一次集成可直接兑换130多种货币

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，西联汇款（Western Union）在 Solana Breakpoint 2026 舞台上展示称，其数字资产网络 Digital Asset Network（DAN）已开放接入。现场幻灯片写明，钱包与平台可通过一次集成接入西联汇款的兑现网络，资金以西联美元稳定币 USDPT 在 Solana 上结算，并可在西联汇款网点、银行或 Stablecard 兑现。幻灯片给出的覆盖范围为超过 40 万个现金领取网点、180 多个国家和地区、130 多种货币，并标注「秒级到账、到账时筛查」。Solana 官方在帖文中称，西联汇款已运营汇款业务 175 年，如今借助 DAN 与 USDPT，一次集成即可在上述范围内兑现。

USDPT 由 Anchorage Digital Bank N.A. 在 Solana 上发行，按 1:1 兑付美元，储备包括银行存款、美国国债及同类现金等价物。西联汇款 5 月 4 日宣布该稳定币上线，并称将把 USDPT 用于代理商近实时结算、交易平台分发以及面向消费者的支付能力。西联汇款官网目前显示，USDPT 已在 Bitso、Bybit、Gate.io、PDAX 和 Kraken 的部分地区上线；通过 DAN 在西联汇款网点将 USDPT 兑成当地法币，以及以 USDPT 收款，目前仍标注适用于部分市场。

items.author: Mark Toon
items.content:
A lesser-known DeFi project getting hacked isn’t exactly breaking news, particularly not in October 2026.
However, a lesser-known DeFi project getting hacked multiple times in just a few days starts to raise some eyebrows.
Garuda DeFi suffered a total of five security incidents between October 20 and 31, a feat that Peter Kacherginsky of crypto security newsletter Blockthreat believes may be “some kind of record for a single project.”
Read more: Binance Labs-backed Initia hacked again, $3.3M lost in three weeks
Garuda DeFi calls itself “the future of DeFi” on Luna Classic (the legacy blockchain which hosted UST before its spectacular 2022 collapse) and Solana.
All of the exploits took place on the former.
Garuda DeFi’s hack attack
On October 20, 36 of the project’s NFT staking factory contracts were migrated, with NFTs and “all rewards from the affected pools” withdrawn.
The following day, its cross-staking pools suffered a similar fate with all staked funds and rewards drained.
A developer wallet was then compromised on October 26 and its assets were drained. The compromised address was used to migrate “governance and protocol fees contracts” and withdraw their funds.
For just over two days, between October 25 and 27, the Garuda DeFi front end was hijacked to inject “malicious wallet approval pop-ups” which would send funds to an attacker-controlled address.
A final scare came on October 31, when the compromised developer wallet obtained admin privileges to “migrate 11 [CW20] staking contracts” and remove the staked assets.
Despite the number of attacks, and Garuda’s assessment that 1.9 trillion tokens were stolen in the first two events alone, it puts the proceeds at just $7,200 worth of LUNC and 176 USDC.

Zelle演示首笔ZLUSD加密转账，借力Solana开启全球化支付进程

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，支付网络 Zelle 在 2026 Breakpoint 大会舞台上演示了其首次使用 ZelleUSD（ZLUSD）进行的加密转账，金额为 125 万美元。现场演示界面标注为 Solana devnet，交易查询亦指向 Solscan 的 devnet。

演示流程显示，Anchorage Digital 先向「Bank Alpha」的 Solana 资金钱包转入 500 万美元 ZLUSD；随后 Bank Alpha 将其中 200 万美元转为加密余额，再向「Bank Beta」发送 125 万美元加密转账，界面提示仅 Zelle 与 Bank Beta 可见金额，并标注为银行间结算。收款方接受后，该笔 125 万美元记入加密余额，界面显示链上不展示金额。Zelle 数字资产合作与战略副总裁 Alexandra Lang 在会上表示：「我们要做的是规模化支付，Solana 具备相应功能，稳定币生态也在成长，这给我们提供了很好的构建空间。」

Zelle 由 Early Warning Services 运营。该公司 2 月公布，Zelle 在 2025 年的支付额超过 1.2 万亿美元。6 月 11 日，Early Warning 宣布将把 Zelle 拓展至海外，首个市场为印度，初期服务预计于 2026 年底前上线，并推出与美元挂钩的自有稳定币 ZelleUSD，用于支持其他市场的国际支付。Solana 官方在帖文中称，这一支付网络「正在走向全球」。

「以太坊在过去两周内暴跌了 28%。这种瀑布式的价格下跌与我们看到的相对积极的基本面发展节奏并不一致，包括多家金融机构和银行宣布在以太坊上构建代币化项目。

我们相信，以太坊价格的这次下跌类似在 SpaceX IPO（2026 年 6 月 11 日）之前抛售。在 SpaceX 定价前的 8 周内，以太坊下跌了 39%。在定价前的两周内，以太坊再次下跌了 29%，价格走势似乎与 SpaceX IPO 之前的以太坊如出一辙，而以太坊在 SpaceX 定价前 3 个交易日触底。」

Banks are banning AI agents over security... and competition concerns
AI agents are set to automate everyday banking tasks — but banks aren’t ready to give up control of the customer relationship just yet.
Banks in the United Kingdom have drawn a line over how much access artificial intelligence should have to their customers’ money.
Four banks, including HSBC, Barclays, Lloyds, NatWest and Nationwide, have all moved to block or restrict third-party AI agents from accessing customer accounts, especially where they can make transactions without customer involvement.
There’s no evidence yet of AI agents accessing UK bank accounts just yet, but large lenders are worried about what happens if an automated system mismanages customers’ money — and who would be on the hook.
The banks might have other, unspoken concerns too.
Edgars Nemše, chief executive of GenLayer Foundation, an AI-focused blockchain infrastructure project, says routine banking tasks like paying bills, moving money and finding better rates could all be handed to agents.
Unfortunately for banks, this means agents would be able to seamlessly find customers a better deal elsewhere as soon as it’s published on the web.
“For plain accounts, that removes the switching costs and makes the space even more competitive,” Nemše tells Magazine.
The risk of agentic bank runs
That scenario could threaten more than just customer loyalty. In September, Apollo chief economist Torsten Slok warned about a possible “agentic bank run.”
If swarms of agents start moving household cash from low-yield checking accounts to alternatives offering higher returns en masse, that would drain banks of the low-cost funding they rely on to make loans. And the speed and scale “would be a problem for the entire financial system.”
Related: Coinbase CEO touts agentic finance as Base tops 100M AI payments
JPMorgan Chase chief executive Jamie Dimon has also warned against allowing external agents unrestricted access to bank accounts. “You don’t want rogue agents,” he said on an October earnings call.
Is an agentic bank run coming? Source: Apollo
Regardless of short-term moves to hold back the tide, AI agents look more and more likely to revolutionize banking within a few years.
Neeraj Makin, group head of strategy analytics at Emirates NBD, predicts agents will usher in a new era of around-the-clock banking and near-instant payments as normal by 2036.
“Forget about waiting for a payment for 24 hours or inter-country payments taking three days… all of that will be in seconds, atomic,” he says, with AI agents taking over most financial decisions.
Banks risk losing the everyday customer interface
Ferdinand Dabitz, chief executive of Augustus, an AI-native banking and payments company, sees a similar shift in how customers interact with financial institutions.
“Every consumer will have 10s and every business will have 100s of agents talking to their bank,” Dabitz says.
A human interface will still remain important for managing those agents and providing a layer of trust, “especially in commercial banking,” he says.
Related: Agents can trade 24/7 — but Yat Siu warns you could lose access at any time
Emirates NBD’s developer experience team argued in July that financial institutions should build their own frameworks for agentic AI, rather than allowing individual teams to develop agents without common controls.
Its Leap framework is designed to govern how agents authenticate with core banking systems, access sensitive data and carry out actions, with audit trails, monitoring and human oversight built in.
Emirates NBD says banks should build their own agentic frameworks. Source: Emirates NBD
However there are still major concerns around the reliability of agents to make major financial decisions on their own.
A recent Bank of England and FCA survey found that while 80% of responding firms had deployed AI agents, just 2% used agents with broad autonomy, identifying data security, third-party dependencies and risks like hallucinations among their biggest concerns.
From paying bills to making financial decisions
The AI takeover likely won’t happen overnight; “it will come in steps,” Nemše says.
“Today I use an agent to review my own and my company’s finances every month and queue the payments, and I approve them. The next step is the natural one: once you trust it, you let it spend small amounts without asking.”
Routine bills, subscriptions and the agent’s own running costs would be among the first tasks to become autonomous, he says.
Dabitz says corporate treasury management could be an area delegated to agents, but says banks will need to be involved in developing these early applications.
Who pays when an agent gets it wrong?
While consumers may enjoy the upside of automating their finances, who’s on the hook when an agent makes a mistake?
Nemše says banks need to offer “delegated access as a normal feature” to avoid customers sharing logins with agents. Customers could set permissions and spending limits, and agents could make low-value transactions independently while requiring approval for larger amounts.
But existing dispute processes may struggle if agents begin making thousands of transactions on behalf of each customer. “Even a small share going wrong is a lot of disputes,” he says. “The processes for handling them were built for people making a few payments a week. That part still has to be built.”
The US Office of the Comptroller of the Currency issued a supervisory framework for banks’ use of what it calls “super intelligence,” including agentic systems, on Nov. 4.
OCC’s Super Intelligence: Supervisory Framework. Source: OCC
The framework is meant to help bank examiners assess how institutions use the technology, and does not introduce new binding requirements for banks. Scrutiny should reflect the potential consequences of an agent’s actions, its level of autonomy and the degree of human oversight.
So an AI system helping a bank employee draft a report would present a different risk from one authorized to move customer funds without approval, and the banks that get that balance right are likely to come out on top.

Strategy buys $33M in Bitcoin, spends $228M on STRC buybacks
Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million and spent $228.1 million repurchasing STRC preferred shares, largely funded by new common stock sales.
Michael Saylor’s Strategy bought 485 Bitcoin for $33.4 million last week while spending nearly seven times as much repurchasing STRC preferred shares.
The company purchased the Bitcoin (BTC) at an average price of $68,887 between Monday and Sunday, bringing its holdings to 850,849 BTC, according to a Monday filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission.
Strategy said it raised $244.7 million by selling 2.09 million common shares (MSTR), using $33.4 million to buy Bitcoin, $206.3 million to fund STRC repurchases and $5 million to its separate cash balance. It funded the remaining $21.8 million in buybacks with interest earned on its cash and short-term investments.
The company repurchased 2.28 million STRC shares during the week. STRC is Strategy’s variable-rate preferred stock, which pays regular dividends to shareholders.
Strategy reported a $4.75 billion US dollar reserve after using $18.9 million to pay preferred stock dividends. Its separate cash balance stood at $151.2 million as of Sunday.
The company also maintained STRC’s annual dividend rate at 12% for December, saying it intends to keep the rate steady until the shares demonstrate sustained trading near $100.
Strategy spent $188.3 million repurchasing STRC shares and $81.9 million buying Bitcoin the previous week.
Strategy’s MSTR stock fell 8.45% to $102.2 in Monday’s premarket trading, while STRC declined 0.78% to $99.1, according to Yahoo Finance. The losses followed MSCI’s confirmation last week that it would remove Strategy from its global equity indexes after the Nov. 30 market close.
Related: Strategy stock sheds 5% amid MSCI index removal, Bitcoin sell-off

Morning Minute is a daily newsletter written by Tyler Warner. The analysis and opinions expressed are his own and do not necessarily reflect those of Decrypt. And check out our daily news show 'FOMO HOUR' covering all of the top stories and market action.
GM!
Today’s top news:
- Crypto majors continue slide after brutal weekend of sell pressure; BTC at $64.2k
- Crypto Fear & Greed hits Extreme Fear after being in Greed just a month ago
- CZ says he and Binance didn’t sell crypto, shares potential reasons for selloff
- Vitalik backs leanPCS as ETH’s best quantum-safe path
- Lighter suspends withdrawals while investigating compromised 3rd party MM
😱 Crypto Hits Extreme Fear as Bitcoin Plunges
The Crypto Fear and Greed Index printed 10 on Sunday. A month ago it read 63, which is Greed. A week ago it was 28. It has been sliding every day since, and 10 is about as low as that gauge goes.
This weekend’s price action certainly was extremely fearful. Bitcoin touched roughly $62,000 before stabilizing in the mid-60s, down about a quarter from its early-October high and down something like 9% in three days. ETH fell under $1,850. Solana, XRP and dogecoin are all down more than 25% on the month. Bitcoin is now trading below its 200-week moving average, a level that has historically acted as the floor beneath every cycle, and it lost its 50-week average a week earlier.
It wasn’t just majors. Zcash fell to $800. Hype fell to $62. VVV went sub-$17. Nothing was spared.
The billion-dollar question of course—why is Bitcoin (and crypto) selling off so hard?
CZ addressed the question directly on Sunday, saying “No one knows for sure. Correlation does not prove causation.” But he did give potential reasons.
Why are crypto prices down?
No one knows for sure. Correlation does not prove causation. Here are some potential reasons.
Money shifting to the Anthropic IPO: https://t.co/jYwVi4huAY
ETF outflows: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs saw about $1.9 billion in outflows over seven trading… pic.twitter.com/XL2aB1ZL9W
— CZ 🔶 BNB (@cz_binance) November 15, 2026
The reasons he listed: money rotating into the Anthropic IPO, ETF outflows, a run of security incidents including the Binance hack itself plus drained iPhone-linked wallets, a Chrome exploit and a Microsoft outage, hot US inflation raising the odds of another Fed hike and strengthening the dollar, and political uncertainty after midterm results that point toward stricter crypto policy.
Those are all pretty valid. Some of those overhangs remove soon (Anthropic IPO), some will fade over time (political uncertainty), but the cyber attack threat will remain until Bitcoin and broader crypto can present a real solution. And if we are faced with a hiking cycle in 2027 due to inflation, that will certainly be a continued headwind.
So where does this leave us? Nvidia reports Tuesday with an interim CEO while its former one openly campaigns to return. The Fed meets December 9 with inflation running hot enough to put another hike in play. And Bitcoin is sitting under a technical level that has held for three cycles.
Extreme fear has marked bottoms before. It has also marked the middle of declines. Now we wait for something other than sentiment to turn.
🌎 Macro Crypto and Markets
- Crypto majors are red after a brutal weekend of selling; BTC -2% at $64.2k; ETH -1% at $1,800; SOL -2% at $71; HYPE -4% at $65; ZEC -6% at $866
- CC (+2%) and FF (+1%) led top alt movers
- Oil even at $88; Gold -0.25% at $3,880
- Stock futures are red as NVDA slides ahead of tomorrow’s earnings; DOW -0.2%, Nasdaq -1.7%
- Jensen Huang has discussed returning as Nvidia’s CEO with allies three days after resigning, per the Financial Times, as a Silicon Valley “war room” lobbies the board and a “Stand with Jensen” petition passes 150,000 signatures including more than 7,500 Nvidia employees; Attorney General Todd Blanche said the Justice Department has not concluded whether the executive at the center of the episode was a spy
- Trump sent four nominations to the Senate for the SEC and CFTC, including the first Democrats he has named to either commission: Nathan Anonick and Matthew Rowland for the CFTC, and Steven Levine and Kristin Johnson for the SEC
- Fed Chair Kevin Warsh will convene a public forum in San Francisco on Monday bringing together technology executives, economists and employers to work out whether AI pushes inflation up or down
- OpenAI launched ChatGPT Wallet, letting AI agents make purchases with Amex, Mastercard and Visa cards without the agent ever seeing the card number
- Vitalik Buterin backed leanPCS as the fastest route to a quantum-safe Ethereum, one of three paths in the draft EIP-8288 he co-authored in June, writing that “over the past few weeks I’ve gone from thinking leanPCS is total bull to being a total bull”; the design bundles many signatures into a single compact proof so the full data never lands onchain
- JPMorgan’s third-quarter 13F showed about $981 million in Bitcoin-linked holdings as of September 30, including roughly $540 million in BlackRock’s IBIT, $301 million in Coinbase and 848,932 Strategy shares, a 36% increase in that position from June

Corporate Treasuries & ETFs

Meme Coin Tracker

- Robinhood chain leaders saw big rebounds Sunday after Saturday’s selloff; Pons -2% to $81M; Cashcat +34% at $53M; AI +15% at $26M; Orbio +10% at $19M; PRIORS +14% and Ubik +13% were other top movers

SemiAnalysis大幅下调AI芯片需求预期：英伟达或承受最大压力

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，AI 研究机构 SemiAnalysis 在最新发布的报告中，大幅下调了 2028 年以后的 AI 芯片、服务器出货及相关资本开支预期，认为前沿 AI 实验室新增 ARR 放缓、融资环境收紧，以及美国数据中心建设延期，将共同压制未来数年的算力扩张。

按该机构新模型，全球 AI 加速器资本开支在 2028 年预计为 7580 亿美元，较此前预测下调 28%；2029 年和 2030 年分别降至 7960 亿美元和 9230 亿美元，较此前预测分别减少 41% 和 40%。报告认为，下调主要来自芯片价格回落、出货量减少，以及未来产品单芯片功耗假设下降。

在主要供应商中，英伟达被认为将承受最大冲击。SemiAnalysis 预计，按计算收入计，英伟达 2027 年至 2030 年的出货预测将分别下调 22%、39%、56% 和 66%。该机构同时下调了英伟达未来 Feynman 系列产品的平均售价预期，其中 Feynman 由约 11 万美元降至约 7.8 万美元，Feynman Ultra 由约 17.5 万美元降至约 9.8 万美元。

报告认为，英伟达面临的压力不仅来自整体需求放缓，还来自客户对成本、能效及融资能力的重新排序。Anthropic 更偏好 TPU、Trainium 和 AMD GPU 等方案，OpenAI 则预计将优先部署自研 ASIC 项目。与此同时，英伟达对 neocloud 客户的敞口较高，而这类客户正面临更大的融资与执行风险。

相比之下，博通被认为受影响最小，其 2026 年至 2030 年 ASIC 收入预测仅下调 11%，主要由 HBM 成本下降导致的价格调整，而非大幅削减出货量。AMD 的预期同样被下调，但其 Meta、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 客户基础，以及相关认股权交易安排，被认为将为需求提供一定支撑。亚马逊 Trainium 在 2027 年至 2028 年的预测则未被下调。

报告的整体判断是，AI 算力建设不会停止，但未来增长将更受融资能力、数据中心供给、芯片价格和客户自研芯片进展的制约；在这一轮重新定价中，英伟达可能成为受影响最明显的供应商。

In brief
- Ledger has launched clear signing on Solana, letting users of its hardware wallets see in plain words what they are approving instead of signing transactions they can't read.
- The feature covers nine Solana apps and 18 of the 22 most common actions on the network, starting with Jupiter and Kamino.
- At Solana Breakpoint, Ledger also promoted Agent Intents for AI agents and its Atom device, which will carry the Solana Seeker app store.
Ledger has brought clear signing to Solana, allowing users of its hardware wallets to read exactly what they are approving before they sign a transaction.
"Until now, most Solana DeFi on a Ledger meant signing blind," the company tweeted on Monday. Users can now verify a swap on decentralized exchange aggregator Jupiter "in plain words, showing what you send and what you get before you approve," it said.
Would you approve a swap you can’t read?
Clear Signing is finally live on Solana. Until now, most Solana DeFi on a Ledger meant signing blind. Now you can verify a Jupiter swap, in plain words, showing what you send and what you get before you approve.Clear Signing now covers… pic.twitter.com/BuW3m7y5GG
— Ledger (@Ledger) November 16, 2026
Blind signing, in which users approve transactions displayed as unreadable data, has long been a weak point for hardware wallet users, since it leaves them unable to spot a malicious request. Ian Rogers, Ledger's chief human agency officer, likened it to "signing a blank check" in a presentation at Solana's Breakpoint conference.
A Jupiter swap that previously meant scrolling through 13 hard-to-read screens on a Ledger device now takes three, showing what the user is giving, what they're getting and who they're dealing with, Rogers said. "It's a huge step for every Solana user," he added.
Clear signing now covers nine Solana apps and 18 of the 22 most common actions users take on the network, according to Ledger. It was built with the Solana Foundation and Anza, the developer of Solana's Agave validator client, with Jupiter and lending protocol Kamino as the first supported apps.
Will HYPE flip SOL in 2026?
Agents and Atom
Rogers also pitched the company's tools for AI agents. Ledger's approach is that an agent "never holds the keys; you do," he said, comparing it to a teenager who has to ask parents for the family car. The agent requests approval when it needs to move funds, and the user signs off on a Ledger device.
Because that means an agent has to stop and wait, Ledger last month launched Agent Intents, a single queue where approval requests collect so agents can keep working while users approve them when convenient. It works with Pay.sh, a service that lets AI agents pay for APIs on Solana, Rogers said.
He also showed off Ledger Atom, the touchscreen device based on Android's open-source code that Ledger announced last month. When it's time to sign, the device switches its screen to Ledger's secure chip, so secrets stay hidden from Android, Rogers said. Atom will be the first hardware beyond the Solana Seeker phone to carry the Seeker platform, bringing its more than 1,500 apps to the device, he added.
Ledger has previously teamed up with MoonPay on tools to let users control AI agents' crypto spending with its hardware wallets.
The launch comes weeks after Ledger investigated a suspected $87 million drain of user funds, which it later said was tied in all confirmed cases to a reseller, Cryptobilis.

【Hyperliquid Policy Center 提交意见书，支持 CFTC 区分事件合约与赌博的两项规则】

Foresight News 消息，Hyperliquid Policy Center（HPC）发推表示，其已向 CFTC 提交意见书，支持 CFTC 于 10 月 19 日发布的两项规则：一项是当日生效的临时最终规则，将州或原住民部落持牌运营方在交易所之外提供的投注和赌场游戏排除在「互换」定义之外；另一项是拟议规则，拟将注册交易所提供的事件合约纳入「互换」定义。HPC 认为，两项规则基于产品提供方及参与方式的风险，在 CFTC 监管的市场与州和部落监管的投注之间划出了客观界线。HPC 在意见书中向 CFTC 提出六项建议，包括：将临时最终规则原文不变地转为最终规则；明确「适用的州或部落法律」是指为运营方发牌的州或部落的法律，而非全美最严格的博彩法；明确州的定性不能将 CFTC 注册市场上交易的合约纳入豁免范围；以及在规则前言中列出赌博产品的典型特征，比如运营方是否作为每笔交易的对手方。

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Solana 基金会宣布，正式退役其网络长期使用的「主网 Beta」标签，并推出「Solana 1.0」作为独立于各个验证者客户端版本的共享协议版本。此举标志着 Solana 在经历了多年的性能优化与网络稳定性考验后，正式进入一个全新的技术成熟阶段。

基金会表示，此次命名变更旨在承认 Solana 在网络性能、韧性和开发者体验方面取得的进展，并简化术语体系。新的「Solana 1.0」将协议版本与各个验证者客户端软件版本分离开来，为开发团队、验证者和基础设施运营商提供了一个统一的参考标准。

基金会强调，此次变更不会对用户产生任何影响，用户的 SOL 持仓、交易历史记录和账户状态均保持不变，无需执行任何操作。不过，由于分配协议版本并不自动激活所有相关的网络改进，开发者和验证者仍需继续遵循各自客户端软件的具体发布指导。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Binance Pay Later offers credit backed by Bitcoin, Ether and BNB holdings
Eligible users can access up to 1,000 USDC in credit against their Bitcoin, Ether or BNB for purchases via Binance Card or QR Pay.
Binance said Monday it would offer eligible users in Argentina and Mexico up to 1,000 USDC in spending credit through Pay Later, a payment feature backed by their cryptocurrency holdings.
Pay Later allows eligible users to access up to 1,000 USDC (USDC) in spending power against their Bitcoin (BTC), Ether (ETH) and BNB (BNB) token holdings as collateral, without selling the underlying assets, Binance said in an announcement shared with Cointelegraph. Borrowing is limited to 50% of the eligible collateral’s value, meaning $2,000 in BTC is required to access a maximum $1,000 credit line.
Purchases are interest-free until the repayment deadline on the first of the following month. Binance’s published FAQ lists a one-day grace period and interest of 0.1% per day, compounding daily, on overdue balances.
Borrowing lets users make purchases without first selling their crypto, but falling prices can put those holdings at risk. Binance can liquidate collateral when the outstanding loan reaches 90% of its value, even before repayment is due. It will initially launch for users in Argentina and Mexico, with a gradual rollout planned for additional markets.
“Traditional consumer credit often relies on income documentation and credit history, which leaves people who hold assets but have no formal credit file with fewer options,” said Thomas Gregory, VP of payments and fiat at Binance, adding that asset-backed credit offers an alternative.
Related: Securitize agrees to buy River One to expand into asset-backed lending
items.title: Binance Pay Later offers credit backed by Bitcoin, Ether and BNB holdings

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments
HKMA and Swift will explore linking Project Ensemble with Swift’s ledger for cross-border payments using tokenized deposits in multiple currencies.
The Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) and Swift will explore connecting their payment infrastructure to support cross-border transfers using tokenized bank deposits, the authority said Monday.
The work will examine links between Swift’s blockchain-based ledger and the settlement infrastructure of Project Ensemble. Participating banks include Bank of China (Hong Kong), Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) and HSBC, according to the announcement.
Tokenized deposits are bank balances represented on a blockchain. They remain claims on the issuing commercial bank, unlike central bank digital currencies, which are claims on a central bank. The proposed Swift connection would explore how separate payment systems could work together across borders in multiple currencies.
The collaboration follows a Nov. 2 upgrade to EnsembleTX, the pilot phase of Project Ensemble, enabling banks to settle tokenized deposit transactions around the clock using tokenized central bank money. The pilot launched in November 2025 and initially relied on Hong Kong’s dollar-denominated real-time gross settlement system.
In July, Swift said its blockchain-based ledger was ready for initial use and that it was preparing to pilot tokenized cross-border payments with 17 major banks, including Citi, DBS and HSBC.
Related: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
items.title: HKMA, Swift explore tokenized deposits for cross-border bank payments

加州通过42号提案，禁止对数字资产等个人资产征新税

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据《洛杉矶时报》报道，加州选民已批准第 42 号提案（Proposition 42），禁止对该州一系列个人资产征收新税。美联社当天宣布该提案获得通过。报道称，在约 96% 的选票完成统计时，赞成票刚过 51%，反对票接近 49%。

第 42 号提案禁止对 401(k) 账户、商业权益、数字资产、知识产权和个人物品等个人财产征收新税，但不包括房地产。除州政府宣布进入紧急状态的情形外，该提案也禁止追溯征税。加州目前一般对收入征税，不对资产的未实现收益征税。

该提案由「Building a Better California」组织推动上票，资助方包括谷歌联合创始人谢尔盖·布林（Sergey Brin）、风险投资人及其他科技高管。加州小企业协会、加州长者联盟和加州职业消防员工会等也予以支持。该提案被作为「毒丸」条款设置，旨在使同日表决、拟对亿万富豪资产征收一次性税的第 40 号提案失效，但第 40 号提案已被选民否决。第 40 号提案支持者表示，可能在 2028 年再次提出财富税；若要针对个人资产征税，需再经选民废止第 42 号提案。

items.content:
民主党要求CFTC撤回预测市场统一规则

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据《华尔街日报》报道，民主党人要求美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）暂停预测市场规则。民主党参议员表示，CFTC 在 11 月 5 日发布的指令必须被撤销。

此前 11 月 5 日，美国商品期货交易委员会（CFTC）发布了一项法律解释，明确受联邦监管的衍生品交易平台（即指定合约市场，DCMs）一般不得基于用户所在的美国州份来封锁其访问。CFTC 要求交易平台在 30 天内（即 12 月 5 日前）取消这些州级地理封锁，否则需向 CFTC 解释为何无法合规。这一举措的法律依据是《商品交易法》中的「公正准入」（Impartial Access）要求，CFTC 认为衍生品市场应作为单一、统一的国家市场运作，而非各州规则的拼凑版图。

这场争端的关键在于预测市场（尤其是涉及体育、政治事件的合约）究竟应被视为受 CFTC 联邦监管的金融衍生品，还是应受各州博彩法管辖的博彩活动。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377598

items.content:
Coinbase与Broadridge发布Onchain Rights Standard，将股东通讯直接送达代币化股权持有人

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，据 Coinbase 官方博客，Coinbase 与 Broadridge 宣布发布 Onchain Rights Standard。该框架旨在将股东通讯及公司行动直接送达代币化股权持有人，并被定位为面向所有代币化方案及后续合作方的公共产品，已发布于 onchainrights.org。

Coinbase 表示，随着代币化股权从概念走向落地，持有人需要获得与真实所有权相应的权利，首先是接收股东通讯，并参与投票等自愿性行动。Broadridge 在链下与链上均提供代理、信息披露、投票和公司行动服务，Coinbase 则提供链上基础设施与工程能力，使上述功能可在钱包层运行。该标准可供任何发行方、托管方或钱包提供商采用，并为在 Base、以太坊生态及其他区块链环境中开发的应用提供共享基础，以便持有人在钱包和应用程序中接收股东通讯并执行投票等操作。Coinbase 称，后续还将把支持范围扩展至其他生态与客户。

对发行方而言，该标准提供了一条路径，使其在推出代币化股权时持有人仍可保留实际股东权利；对持有人而言，代币化股份并非被剥离权利的合成工具，而是具备真实所有权，并带有互联网原生升级。双方合作的下一阶段将推动实现链上代理投票。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377592
items.title: Coinbase与Broadridge发布Onchain Rights Standard，将股东通讯直接送达代币化股权持有人

items.content:
英特尔遭股东集体诉讼：被指隐瞒PC业务疲软，财报「报喜不报忧」

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，英特尔及其首席执行官陈立武（Lip-Bu Tan）和首席财务官大卫·津斯纳（David Zinsner）近日面临一项拟议的股东集体诉讼。原告指控这家芯片制造商未能向投资者充分披露其个人电脑（PC）业务面临的需求放缓与库存积压问题，导致随后股价暴跌，市值蒸发约 1400 亿美元。这起诉讼由密歇根州南菲尔德市消防与警察退休基金牵头，于 11 月 13 日提交至加州圣何塞联邦法院（案号：5:26-cv-13758），代表在 2026 年 7 月 23 日至 10 月 29 日期间持有英特尔股票的投资者提出索赔。诉讼的核心焦点集中在英特尔在业绩承压期间的大规模融资行为。

诉状指出，今年 8 月 12 日，英特尔以每股 95 美元的价格发行了约 2.42 亿股股票，筹集了约 230 亿美元资金，用于支持其半导体制造扩张。原告认为，在 PC 市场持续低迷、库存高企的背景下，英特尔有动机在融资时隐瞒真实的业务困境。不过，诉状也客观指出，股票发行的完成本身并不构成不当行为，目前的争议在于英特尔在发行期间是否向投资者充分披露了业务状况。

这起诉讼的导火索是英特尔 10 月 29 日发布的第三季度财报及低于预期的业绩指引。尽管当季总营收同比增长 21% 至 165 亿美元，且数据中心和人工智能部门营收大增 78% 至 73 亿美元，但包含 PC 业务的客户端计算与物理 AI 集团营收下滑 5% 至 81 亿美元。英特尔对第四季度的销售指引仅为 150 亿至 160 亿美元，远低于市场预期。公司高管坦言，PC 需求放缓预计至少将持续到 2027 年上半年，同时制造供应短缺和内存芯片涨价进一步压制了市场需求。

黄仁勋倒下后，美国商务部长也被查：拖着不收紧芯片管制，儿子的投行还在帮相关企业融资

动察 Beating AI 快讯，黄仁勋辞职后，压力开始落到美国商务部长 Howard Lutnick 身上。他目前还在任，但白宫已经在讨论要不要撤换他。

《纽约时报》11 月 15 日又挖出一条重磅线索：Lutnick 一直主张放宽海外数据中心的英伟达芯片限制，而他过去掌管、如今由两个儿子经营的投行 Cantor Fitzgerald，恰好在为相关企业提供金融服务。

其中一家是新加坡公司比特小鹿。它准备在马来西亚建设一座配备英伟达 GB300 芯片的数据中心，预计 2027 年投入运营。知情人士称，这座机房很可能为腾讯提供算力。

Bitdeer 已为这座机房超过 70% 的容量找到客户，预计未来五年收入超过 17 亿美元。Cantor Fitzgerald 与它的合作始于 2024 年，今年又成为其最高 10 亿美元股票发行计划的销售代理之一。

这门生意利用了美国芯片限制留下的空间：中国企业不能直接购买部分顶级英伟达芯片，却仍能租用马来西亚等地的 GPU。芯片不进入中国，企业照样能在海外使用这些算力。

美国政府原本准备收紧这类交易。但《纽约时报》发现，Lutnick 主张只管新加坡、马来西亚等 7 个国家，而且只限制今后出口的芯片，已经建好的机房可以不受新规约束。中国客户用这些算力训练 AI，运营商只需申报，不必一律事先申请许可。

Lutnick 在黄仁勋丑闻中也早已受到质疑。据 Axios 报道，他此前收到过关于黄仁勋与 Alice Huang 关系的机密预警，却迟迟没有对她任职过的英伟达客户 Megaspeed 采取贸易限制措施。

11 月 13 日，美国财政部长 Scott Bessent 公开表示，财政部、国防部、国务院和贸易代表办公室，几个月前就赞成把 Megaspeed 列入出口黑名单，但决定权在商务部手里。

如今，共和党和民主党议员都要求 Lutnick 解释，为什么商务部迟迟没有采取行动。他已同意 12 月 10 日赴国会作证。11 月 16 日，民主党参议员 Maria Cantwell 又致函指责商务部未能堵住芯片管制漏洞。

美国商务部否认 Lutnick 的政策受到家族生意影响，称他已转让相关持股，也不会与儿子讨论部门事务。

Lighter Suspected of User Account Drains; Temporarily Suspends Withdrawals and Liquidity Pool Creation

Lighter said it is investigating a suspected security incident involving the compromise of a single external party and has temporarily suspended all withdrawals and liquidity pool creation. Blockchain analyst MLM reported that an address withdrew $10.39 million in USDC from Lighter and swapped it for approximately 5,750 ETH through CoW Protocol. Analyst 0xTria cited Korean community analysis suggesting leaked API keys belonging to two market makers may have enabled the transfers, rather than a protocol vulnerability. The two accounts reportedly involved approximately $15.48 million in total, while LIT briefly fell more than 17%.

Lighter said its investigation found that the security incident was caused by a trader's leaked API key, with no impact on the protocol or smart contracts. As a precaution, it has enabled Guardian mode and plans to have its Security Council execute a contract upgrade to recover funds involved in a second withdrawal attempt by the attacker. Withdrawals remain suspended, with the platform targeting a resumption later today. — link

特斯拉自动驾驶团队出走创业：估值11亿美元，专门给机器人造虚拟世界

动察 Beating AI 快讯，三名特斯拉自动驾驶仿真团队前负责人创办的 Zeromatter 正式亮相，估值达到 11 亿美元，累计融资 1.6 亿美元。公司已有超过 130 名员工，其中约 40 人也来自特斯拉。

三名创始人此前都是游戏开发者。CEO Ian Glow 曾参与开发 Minecraft，后来带领特斯拉的仿真团队，为自动驾驶和 Optimus 人形机器人搭建虚拟测试环境。

Zeromatter 把这套技术做成了独立产品。客户可以在虚拟世界里训练自动驾驶汽车、无人机和机器人，反复测试危险或罕见场景。比如模拟儿童突然从停放的汽车后方冲出，或者让机器人尝试抓取、安装零件，不必在现实中冒险。

它的重点是让模拟结果尽可能接近现实。公司自研了物理引擎和传感器模拟系统，不仅要还原画面，还要模拟碰撞、摩擦、摄像头误差等细节。团队会购买真实设备，在实验室测量各种情况，再与虚拟结果逐一比较。

Glow 认为，机器人走路、跑步已经取得很大进展，真正困难的是让双手准确操作物体。Zeromatter 正在重点攻克这类需要精确模拟接触和摩擦的任务。

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
Singapore, Germany test cross-border FX settlement with CBDCs
Project Simbolon aims to reduce the cost and time of cross-border settlement and promote common standards for payments and FX
The Monetary Authority of Singapore (MAS) and the Deutsche Bundesbank used wholesale central bank digital currencies (CBDCs) to test settlement of euro–Singapore dollar trades across their separate digital asset test environments.
As part of Project Simbolon, the two central banks used payment-versus-payment settlement, meaning the final transfers of each currency depended on the final transfer of the other, MAS said in a Monday press release. Zero-knowledge proofs allowed each system to verify whether settlement conditions were met without directly integrating the central bank ledgers.
The project aims to make cross-border transfers between Singapore and Germany faster and cheaper. It also aims to promote common standards for cross-border payments, foreign exchange and securities transactions tied to tokenized assets.
The test was the first milestone under a November 2025 memorandum of understanding between the two central banks on tokenization and cross-border settlement. It also advances broader efforts to make tokenized financial markets more efficient under Project Guardian, a tokenization initiative MAS launched in May 2022.
“Project Simbolon paves the way for eliminating settlement risk in global foreign exchange transactions,” said Sabine Mauderer, first deputy governor of the Bundesbank.
In September, the Eurosystem launched Pontes, a system that lets financial institutions settle wholesale tokenized asset transactions in central bank money.
Related: DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
items.title: Singapore, Germany test cross-border FX settlement with CBDCs

items.author: Cointelegraph by William Suberg
items.content:
BTC price tags 18-week low into Nvidia earnings: Three things to know in Bitcoin this week
Bitcoin traders awaited Nvidia Q3 earnings after BTC price selling pressure saw a dip below $62,000 at the weekend.
Bitcoin (BTC) traded around $64,500 early Monday after a sell-off in thin weekend trading sent it to a four-month low of $61,950.
Key points:
- Bitcoin fell below its 200-week simple moving average, now at $68,186.
- Nvidia reports third-quarter earnings Tuesday following Jensen Huang’s resignation, with the company forecasting about $108 billion in revenue.
- Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh speaks Monday, and minutes of the Fed’s October policy meeting are due Wednesday.
Bitcoin falls below its 200-week moving average
Data from TradingView showed that BTC/USD fell to $61,950 on Bitstamp, a level last seen on July 13. The pair briefly rebounded to $66,000 before easing to around $64,500 during Monday’s Asian trading session.
BTC/USD one-hour chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
The drop pushed Bitcoin below its 200-week simple moving average (SMA) of $68,186. This cemented concerns about Bitcoin’s rebound to $87,000, which began in August, as flipping the 200-week SMA from resistance to support has been a prerequisite for previous bear-market recoveries.
“Deviating below the 200-week SMA has historically been the key to building out a Bear Market bottom formation,” crypto trader and analyst Rekt Capital said Saturday on X.
BTC/USD one-week chart with 200-week SMA. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
From Friday to 10 am UTC on Monday, Bitcoin open interest fell by around 9.1% to $20.98 billion, according to onchain analytics platform CryptoQuant.
A CryptoQuant contributing analyst drew comparisons to similar open interest drawdowns in February and June, considering whether Bitcoin was forming a local bottom.
“If the flush is complete, a bottoming zone may be near. If shorts keep piling up, even a modest rally could squeeze them. The $59K-$60K summer low remains the next key test,” the analyst wrote on Sunday.
Bitcoin open interest. Source: CryptoQuant
Bitcoin perpetual futures funding rates briefly turned negative near the weekend low, meaning traders with short positions paid those with long positions.
Bitcoin funding rates. Source: CryptoQuant
Nvidia earnings due Tuesday as allies push for Huang’s return
Nvidia remains in the spotlight this week as the tech giant reports third-quarter results after US markets close Tuesday amid ongoing controversy over former CEO Jensen Huang.
On Tuesday, interim CEO Colette Kress will lead the company’s earnings call. Nvidia previously forecast quarterly revenue of around $108 billion, and analysts expect earnings per share to nearly double year over year.
Huang is reportedly considering a return to Nvidia. He resigned last week after reports that he had an affair with a chip executive whom US authorities suspect of spying for China. Beijing denied the espionage allegation.
The Financial Times reported that a “war room” of tech CEOs and others was lobbying for his reinstatement, while an open letter calling for his return has garnered more than 165,000 signatories, including Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk.
“A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too,” Musk said in an X post on Friday.
The efforts face friction from US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, who said that Nvidia should hire its next CEO from outside the company.
“This makes me think that as the board conducts a search for a new leader that they need to go outside the company, that just [with] what was going on inside the company, they need a dramatic shakeup,” he told Fox News.
Nvidia shares closed Friday at $162.85, down 12.7% for the week. On Thursday, shares fell to $148.80, their lowest since mid-2025, before recovering some of their losses.
Nvidia stock one-week chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Nvidia headlines rattled tech stocks and crypto markets last week. Investors will be watching the company’s outlook for signs of how demand for AI chips is holding up.
Fed minutes due as markets price in December rate hike
Fed officials will speak throughout the week as traders look for clues about the December rate decision.
Related: Here’s what happened in crypto today
Warsh will deliver opening remarks at the Fed’s Productivity and Jobs Task Force Conference in San Francisco at 9 am PT (5 pm UTC) on Monday. He will also moderate two panels and a fireside chat.
On Wednesday, the Fed will release minutes of its Oct. 27–28 policy meeting. Officials left rates unchanged at 3.75% to 4%, and Warsh cited “resilient” domestic spending in the face of global geopolitical uncertainty.
After the latest economic data, markets fully priced in a quarter-point rate hike from the Fed in December. Last week’s Consumer Price Index (CPI) beat expectations, and while the Producer Price Index (PPI) reading was lower than anticipated, the annual increase was still the largest in four years.
Meanwhile, the 10-year US Treasury yield rose above 5%, and the Japanese yen brought back a familiar headwind for crypto markets as it weakened past the key psychological level of 160 per US dollar on Friday.
USD/JPY one-day chart. Source: Cointelegraph/TradingView
Japan’s economy shrank at an annualized rate of 0.1% in the third quarter, according to data released Monday. The contraction complicates the outlook for further rate hikes in Japan, where the policy rate is already at a three-decade high of 1.25%.
“With the yen perched precariously at 160 per dollar, a combination of sluggish domestic growth and sticky price pressures, if they were to materialize, would complicate life for both the Bank of Japan and the Ministry of Finance,” economist Mohamed El-Erian wrote over the weekend.

美联储理事巴尔：AI智能体可能加剧未来的银行挤兑

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，美联储理事巴尔警告称，自主性 AI 智能体可能通过根据市场信号或利率变化自动转移客户存款，加速引发破坏性的银行挤兑。巴尔指出，大型银行已经检测到 AI 智能体试图在个人账户中采取未经授权的操作。

巴尔表示：「过去客户需要亲自执行转账，而 AI 智能体可以瞬间识别收益率差异或稳定性信号，并以极快的速度自主转移资金。这可能会加速挤兑进程，使其在几分钟内迅速爆发，从而令传统的流动性管理措施和监管干预机制措手不及。」

尽管对 AI 的长期前景持乐观态度，但巴尔也提醒称，AI 若要取得成功，必须辅以必要的护栏措施，例如「针对特定操作进行明确的授权验证、通过技术手段限制智能体的能力，以及建立基于规则和价值观的双重约束机制。」此外，巴尔还指出了 AI 基础设施繁荣中的脆弱性，提到超过 3 万亿美元的表外负债以及科技巨头之间存在的循环融资问题。

谷歌Antigravity密集上新：电脑操作即将上线，Carbon提速、手机App也在做

动察 Beating AI 快讯，谷歌 Antigravity 负责人 Varun Mohan 宣布，Antigravity 已将 Gemini 4 Argon、Carbon、Hydrogen 三款模型的上下文窗口扩大一倍。每轮对话触发的上下文压缩次数可减少约 3.5 倍，让 Agent 在长任务中少花时间整理历史信息。

Varun 还透露，Antigravity 即将加入原生电脑操作（Computer Use）功能，让 Agent 能够直接操作桌面软件。

不少开发者在 Varun 和 Google DeepMind 的 Gemini 后训练负责人 Melvin Johnson 的评论区抱怨，Carbon 虽然能力很强，但运行速度太慢。Melvin 承认正在提速，并透露团队已有兼顾速度与模型能力的方案。Varun 则表示，此次上下文扩容也能减少压缩耗时，加快任务完成。

有用户希望推出每月 300 美元、500 美元的更高额度套餐，Varun 回复称「正在做」。Melvin 还透露，Antigravity 移动 App 已在规划当中。

过去一周，Antigravity 还接连上线 Gemini 4 Carbon、Hydrogen 两款模型，推出 Swarm 多 Agent 并行协作、Orchestrator 不同模型分工，以及用 Python 编排 Agent 任务的 Dynamic Workflows。

Foresight News 消息，据 Decrypt 报道，德国联邦议院已于 11 月 12 日通过一项强化海关打击金融犯罪权力的法案（Zollfinanzgerechtigkeitsgesetz），授权海关在未启动刑事调查的情况下，扣押合法来源存疑的资产，其中明确包括加密资产。该法案主要针对价值通常超过约 11.1 万美元（10 万欧元）的「重大」资产，所有人需证明其资产来源合法。德国财政部长 Lars Klingbeil 表示，海关可在无定罪的情况下扣押相关资产最长 180 天，永久没收则需由财政法院法官合议庭裁定。该法案还将加强海关对跨境数字支付渠道的监控，德国政府预计其可带来约 3.42 亿美元（3.08 亿欧元）的额外收入。该法案尚需联邦参议院批准，计划于 2027 年 1 月 1 日生效。

欧洲央行副行长：市场对2027年进一步加息预期并非不合理

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，欧洲央行副行长武伊契奇表示，市场对欧洲央行将在 2027 年进一步收紧货币政策，这种预期或许是准确的。这位来自克罗地亚的官员重申，借贷成本的调整路径并未预先设定；他指出，当前的通胀前景有必要采取进一步、审慎的应对措施。这意味着，继伊朗冲突爆发以来已实施两次加息之后，欧洲央行可能会继续循序渐进地提高利率。

武伊契奇表示：「从目前的情况来看，市场预期明年还会加息，这并非不合理。但从现在到那时，还有很多变数。」在谈到 12 月会议上加息的可能性时，武伊契奇表示：「我看不出有什么理由要改变既定的路线图。」当前投资者押注，继 12 月份加息之后，欧洲央行在 2027 年将把存款利率上调两次，每次幅度为 25 个基点。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Germany's Bundestag has passed a law letting customs officials seize assets of doubtful origin, explicitly including crypto, without first opening a criminal case.
- The powers target "significant" assets, generally those worth more than €100,000 ($111,000), whose owners would have to show they were lawfully obtained.
- The government expects about €308 million ($342 million) in extra revenue, but opposition lawmakers say the law will catch cash couriers rather than sophisticated launderers.
Germany's parliament has approved sweeping new powers for the country's customs agency, allowing it to seize assets, including crypto, whose lawful origin is in doubt, even when no criminal investigation is underway.
The Bundestag passed the Customs Financial Justice Act, or Zollfinanzgerechtigkeitsgesetz, on Thursday, November 12, the German government said. Under the law, customs can more easily seize assets where there are "justified doubts" about their lawful origin, an instrument the government describes as a "suspicious wealth order." Customs will also be able to better monitor digital cross-border payment routes and secure crypto assets.
"With this, we are sending a clear signal to criminals: we are getting tougher," German Finance Minister Lars Klingbeil said, according to the government.
Proving where it came from
The powers apply to "significant" assets, which typically means those worth more than €100,000, according to the government's bill. Because owners of such assets are usually able to explain where they came from, while the state struggles to prove an illegal origin, the government argued that it is reasonable to ask owners to disclose that information. "Almost every law-abiding citizen will be able to explain where these assets came from," the bill's explanatory notes say, as summarized by the Bundestag's news service.
Klingbeil has said customs could hold assets for up to 180 days without a conviction, during which owners would have to show they were obtained legally. "The Porsche and the Rolex are then gone for now," he said, according to the Berliner Zeitung. Any permanent confiscation would require a court ruling. Following an amendment by the governing coalition, that decision will be made by a panel of finance court judges rather than a single judge.
The law also reorganizes Germany's customs administration, strengthens its Financial Intelligence Unit and gives customs a legal basis to use technologies such as artificial intelligence. It forms part of an action plan against organized crime that the government adopted on February 25, 2026.
Germany's Bitcoin seizures and sales
Germany has seized large amounts of crypto before, and has been quick to sell it. In 2024, authorities in the state of Saxony began selling the nearly 50,000 BTC they had seized from operators of the movie piracy website Movie2K, moving hundreds of millions of dollars' worth at a time as the sell-off continued. Blockchain analytics firm Arkham later said authorities had failed to seize a further 45,000 BTC linked to the site. The new law would give customs a way to seize crypto of unclear origin without first having to tie it to a specific crime.
German authorities have also gone after laundering infrastructure. Last year, they joined Swiss police in shutting down Cryptomixer, a mixing service that had laundered more than $1.4 billion in Bitcoin since 2016. Separately, the finance ministry has drafted a 25% tax on crypto gains from 2027.
Critics question its reach
The Bundestag's finance committee backed the bill on Wednesday with votes from the governing CDU/CSU and SPD, as well as the far-right AfD. The Left Party voted against, and the Greens abstained.
The Greens said Germany's money laundering problem is estimated at €100 billion, and that the government's expectation of only €308 million in additional revenue showed the gap between its ambitions and the law. The Left Party said the confiscation process was "built for the cash courier, not the banker."
The law still needs to pass the Bundesrat, the upper house of parliament that represents Germany's states.

Solana正式告别Mainnet Beta，升级至1.0协议版本

BlockBeats 消息，11 月 16 日，Solana 基金会发文宣布，Solana 网络将从「Mainnet Beta」正式转为「Mainnet」，并启用统一的 Solana 1.0 协议版本，结束自网络上线以来沿用的 Beta 标识。此次调整由 Solana 基金会联合 Anza 和 Firedancer 团队推进。此次升级主要是对网络技术进展及协议版本管理方式的确认，并非更换底层网络。对于普通用户而言，无需采取任何操作，SOL、账户、资产、应用及交易历史均不会发生变化。

Solana 基金会表示，Alpenglow 已在主网激活，使验证者达成共识的方式发生变化，并将交易最终确认时间缩短至约 150 毫秒。此外，独立于 Agave 开发的验证者客户端 Firedancer 逐步部署，有助于提升客户端多样性，降低单一代码库漏洞对网络造成的影响，增强网络韧性。

Solana 1.0 还将建立统一的协议版本标识。此前，Agave 和 Firedancer 拥有各自独立的代码库、发布周期及软件版本号；新的协议版本将用于描述整个 Solana 网络的演进，而不再以某一客户端的版本号代表全网。基金会同时强调，协议版本发布并不意味着相关功能会立即全部激活。开发者、验证者及 RPC 运营商仍需根据各客户端的兼容版本和具体升级指引进行操作。

items.author: Decrypt Agent
items.content:
In brief
- Vitalik Buterin threw his support behind leanPCS, one of three proposed ways to aggregate bulky quantum-safe signatures and proofs on Ethereum.
- Quantum-safe signatures and proofs are far larger than today's, and Buterin said his draft proposal, EIP-8288, would keep most of that data off the chain.
- He argued leanPCS could be implemented quickly, while a more general option, leanSTARK, would require Ethereum to agree on a new programming language.
Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin has thrown his weight behind a proposal he says could make the network quantum-safe much faster than expected.
"Over the past few weeks I've gone from thinking leanPCS is total bull to being a total bull," Buterin tweeted on Monday, in a lengthy explainer on how Ethereum could handle the much larger signatures and proofs that quantum-resistant cryptography requires.
Over the past few weeks I've gone from thinking leanPCS is total bull to being a total bull. So let me explain some of these buzzwords in more detail.
At the core, 8288 is about hyper-scaling data and execution for any computation that needs to get performed on a piece of data…
— vitalik.eth (@VitalikButerin) November 16, 2026
In short, leanPCS is a proposed way for Ethereum to bundle many large, quantum-safe signatures and proofs into a single compact proof, so that the full data never has to be stored onchain. It is built on polynomial commitment schemes, or PCS, the core mathematical building block of STARK proofs.
Quantum computers are expected to eventually break the elliptic curve cryptography that secures Ethereum and Bitcoin accounts today. The quantum-safe replacements are far bulkier: Buterin said signatures would grow from 65 bytes to between 1 and 6 kilobytes, while zero-knowledge proofs would balloon from a few hundred bytes to around 128 kilobytes. "This is unsustainable to put on chain," he wrote.
EIP-8288's three paths forward
Buterin's answer is EIP-8288, a draft proposal he co-authored with developer Thomas Coratger in June, which would aggregate those signatures and proofs before they ever reach a block.
Under the design, users publish their signatures or proofs, and network nodes repeatedly bundle everything they have seen into a single STARK, a type of zero-knowledge proof, that attests the underlying data is valid. These aggregate proofs are themselves combined until a single "master proof" verifies everything in a block. Only short claims, rather than the full signatures or proofs, would need to be stored onchain.
He laid out three ways to build it, depending on what users submit. The simplest, leanSPHINCS, would support a single type of quantum-safe, hash-based signature, costing users only a small amount of gas per signature, but it couldn't do anything else.
ETH price on November 22, 4:59PM UTC
At the other end, leanSTARK would be fully general, allowing any signature scheme, privacy protocols or hidden multisig logic. But Ethereum would first have to agree on a programming language for users' programs, which Buterin called "the first big case of 'Ethereum moving beyond the EVM,'" and which is likely to take time.
Buterin's preferred option, leanPCS, offers a third route. It would offer the same generality as leanSTARK but "could potentially be implemented very quickly," he said, because far fewer design choices are needed, and leanSTARK could then be added later.
"So there is a route to getting 'the cryptographic proof singularity' much faster than any of us expected," Buterin wrote, "and that route runs through 8288 with leanPCS."
Quantum-safe signatures today
Buterin linked to SPHINCS-, a family of hash-based signature schemes optimized for Ethereum, which was published on the Ethereum Research forum in June with input from Buterin and Ethereum Foundation cryptographers. The post shows that a standards-aligned quantum-safe signature can already be verified on Ethereum for about 150,000 gas, without any protocol change, compared with about 3,000 gas for an ECDSA signature today, according to an earlier Buterin estimate.
Under protocol-level aggregation, a future "leanSPHINCS" verification would cost about 3,000 gas, according to the post.
Quantum resistance has become a top priority for Ethereum. The Ethereum Foundation formed a dedicated post-quantum team in January, and Buterin has since said the network is betting its future on quantum security and privacy. Developers have also proposed overhauling the staking deposit contract to support post-quantum validator keys, and Buterin has pushed a plan to cut the cost of quantum-safe privacy.

items.content:
In brief
- Elon Musk said he is signing a petition calling on Nvidia's board to reinstate Jensen Huang, which has drawn more than 160,000 signatures.
- Huang has discussed returning as CEO with confidants, and allies are assembling a "war room" to lobby for his comeback, the Financial Times reported.
- Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said Nvidia should look outside the company for its next CEO, while analysts are split on whether Huang could return.
Elon Musk has thrown his support behind a campaign to reinstate Jensen Huang as Nvidia's CEO, as the ousted chipmaker co-founder reportedly weighs a comeback just days after resigning.
"A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I'm signing it too," the Tesla and SpaceX CEO tweeted on Friday. Musk had previously said it would be "an honor" to hire Huang.
A petition is underway to reinstate Jensen and I’m signing it too
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) November 13, 2026
The "Stand with Jensen" open letter calls on Nvidia's board to bring Huang back while an independent investigation establishes the facts. It has drawn more than 160,000 signatures, including Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney and Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan, CNBC reported, though the site notes that signatories' affiliations are self-reported and unverified. More than 7,500 signatories identified themselves as Nvidia employees, The Guardian reported, a figure it said was equivalent to 18% of the company's workforce.
The campaign follows internal calls from Nvidia staff for Huang's return.
A comeback in the works?
Huang has discussed the possibility of returning with confidants, the Financial Times reported, citing multiple people familiar with the matter. One ally told the newspaper they were assembling a "war room" of Silicon Valley executives to lobby for his reinstatement and would seek support from the White House, adding that the effort had Huang's backing.
Even supporters acknowledged the obstacles. "Having an affair with a subordinate is a fireable offence," one person involved in the effort told the FT.
Two major Nvidia shareholders, Altimeter Capital's Brad Gerstner and Atreides Management's Gavin Baker, urged the board in an open letter on Friday to leave "all options on the table, including the potential return of Jensen Huang."
Huang resigned as Nvidia's president, CEO and board member on Thursday, capping a week of reports of affairs with Alice Huang, a former executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed whom U.S. officials suspect of spying for China, and with an Nvidia executive who reported to him. Chief financial officer Colette Kress is serving as interim CEO.
Washington pushes back
The campaign faces resistance in Washington. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said on Sunday that Nvidia should look outside the company for its next CEO. "They need a dramatic shake-up," he told Fox News.
Bessent said on Sunday Morning Futures that questions over Nvidia's compliance with U.S. export restrictions were the bigger issue, and that the company should be judged on whether it had "intentionally ignored the warning signs" of shell companies in Singapore. He said he wanted answers "in the next 10 days from the board and from the outside counsel." Huang also faces congressional inquiries into Nvidia's chip exports to China, as well as a proposed shareholder class action.
Nvidia's board has approached Arm CEO Rene Haas as a potential successor, the FT has reported. "We are in the process of selecting a search firm for the NVIDIA CEO role. We have not formally engaged any potential candidates," an Nvidia spokesperson told CNBC.
Analysts are divided on Huang's chances. "We see no chance Jensen comes back to Nvidia as CEO," Dan Ives of Yorkville Ives & Co. said in a note cited by CNBC, while Seaport Research Partners' Jay Goldberg said Huang could stage "a second act" if he gets through his legal troubles. Former White House communications director Anthony Scaramucci was blunter: "The FBI doesn't take petitions," he tweeted.
Nvidia reports quarterly earnings on Tuesday, the first under Kress.

items.content:
乌兰察布AI基建有多疯狂：25GW算力项目已签约，近3万人同时赶工

动察 Beating AI 快讯，前段时间，美国研究机构 SemiAnalysis 专程来到内蒙古乌兰察布，将规划 800MW 的远景星河基地称为「中国版 Stargate」。然而，这座足以与美国超大型 AI 数据中心相提并论的园区，在乌兰察布只能算冰山一角。一场规模更加庞大的算力建设，正在这片草原上铺开。

根据当地公开数据，截至今年 10 月中旬，乌兰察布累计签约 109 个算力中心项目，签约 IT 供电容量超过 25GW，规划机架规模超过 700 万架。

《晚点》记者近期在乌兰察布实地走访了 72 小时。当地察哈尔高新区就有 22 个算力项目同时施工，近 3 万名工人在不同工地赶工。

在巴音片区，十几辆几十米长的板车排成一排，运载着数百个尚未拆封的服务器机柜。道路两侧有 4 个数据中心同时建设，到了晚上，塔吊和挖掘机还在施工。一些工地每三个月就要完成一栋机房楼。

客户要求的交付时间也越来越短。远景 AI 智算中心 CTO 胡兴赞透露，过去客户能接受 12 个月的建设周期，后来缩短到 9 个月、6 个月，现在甚至要求两三个月交付。

因为 GPU 太贵，机房延期一天，就可能让价值数十亿元的计算设备继续闲置。一名项目负责人透露，如果未能按合同交付机房，每晚一天就要赔偿客户 50 万元，一个月就是 1500 万元。

为了赶工，建设方开始提前拿地、建设厂房、采购大型设备。部分配电系统直接在工厂组装成模块，运到现场后再连接。原本需要 10 天的安装工作，可以压缩到 2 天。

原文链接 https://m.theblockbeats.info/flash/377555
items.title: 乌兰察布AI基建有多疯狂：25GW算力项目已签约，近3万人同时赶工

items.author: Cointelegraph by Zoltan Vardai
items.content:
DBS, JPMorgan’s Kinexys launch 24/7 transfers of tokenized deposits
Ant International is the first customer to use the service, which lets clients transfer US dollar deposits between Singapore and the US.
DBS and JPMorgan launched a service on Monday that lets clients transfer tokenized US dollar deposits between the two banks around the clock.
Tokenized deposits are bank deposits represented on the blockchain. The service connects DBS Token Services with JPMorgan’s Kinexys platform for transfers between Singapore and the US, according to a press release.
Ant International became the first client to use service to manage its cash across markets.
The launch supports the Monetary Authority of Singapore’s Project BLOOM, which aims to make it easier to use tokenized deposits and regulated stablecoins for payments in Singapore and across borders. The central bank launched the project in October 2025.
DBS and JPMorgan co-lead Project BLOOM’s working group on transfers between blockchain platforms. The two banks first revealed plans to develop a blockchain-based tokenization framework for onchain transfers in November 2025.
More than half of the 422 business leaders DBS surveyed across 11 markets said their companies used tokenized deposits or planned to do so, according to the bank’s Oct. 28 report.
Related: Citi, DBS complete first weekend tokenized cross-border deposit on Swift
